006301: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_atomic_aggregate_access_representable(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type)
006302: {
006303:     IrType* qualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006304:     IrType* unqualified = qualified && qualified->is_atomic ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, qualified->unqualified_type) : 0;
006305:     bool result = true;
006306:     if (unqualified && (unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION) && qualified->layout.resolved)
006307:     {
006308:         u64 width = qualified->layout.size;
006309:         bool wide_pair = width == 16 && (builder->target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_X86_64 || builder->target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_AARCH64);
006310:         result = width == 1 || width == 2 || width == 4 || width == 8 || wide_pair;
006311:     }
006312: 
006313:     return result;
006314: }
006315: 
006316: /* Whether every atomic access the lowered body kept has a canonical IR
006317:    representation the backend can inspect.
006318: 
006319:    Asked here, over the finished body, rather than where the access is built:
006320:    an operand is lowered as a value first, and an expression that only wanted
006321:    its address then recovers the place and drops the load again, so refusing at
006322:    the emit site rejects `&object.atomic_member` -- which performs no atomic
006323:    access at all, and is exactly the shape tests/basic_c_packed_layout.c writes
006324:    over a seventeen-byte atomic member.  This walks the block chains, which is
006325:    what code generation walks, so an unlinked instruction is never blamed.
006326: 
006327:    The blame is the function rather than a token: an instruction carries a
006328:    source range and not the token index the failure funnel wants, and two
006329:    tokens sharing a spelling offset would make a search for one answer with the
006330:    wrong occurrence. */
006331: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_atomic_aggregate_accesses_lowerable(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
006332: {
006333:     IrFunction* function = builder->function;
006334:     bool supported = true;
006335:     // The walk exists for the six functions in a self-compile that hold an
006336:     // atomic access; the opcode summary the builder maintained while
006337:     // appending answers "none here" for every other one without touching a
006338:     // row, and a summary it never established reads as "maybe", which keeps
006339:     // the walk for hand-built IR.  Measured on the stage-1 self-host: the
006340:     // unconditional walk was 0,5% of the compile's instructions.
006341:     bool may_hold_atomic =
006342:         ir_function_may_contain_opcodes(function, IR_OPCODE_BIT(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD) | IR_OPCODE_BIT(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_STORE));
006343:     for (u32 block_index = 0; may_hold_atomic && block_index < function->block_count && supported; block_index += 1)
006344:     {
006345:         IrInstructionId instruction_id = function->blocks[block_index].first_instruction;
006346:         while (instruction_id.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && supported)
006347:         {
006348:             IrInstruction* instruction = function->instructions + instruction_id.value;
006349:             bool atomic_access = instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_STORE;
006350:             if (atomic_access && instruction->operand_count && instruction->operands[0].value < function->value_count)
006351:             {
006352:                 IrTypeId place_type = function->values[instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type;
006353:                 if (!c_ir_atomic_aggregate_access_representable(builder, place_type))
006354:                 {
006355:                     IrType* qualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, place_type);
006356:                     builder->failure_message = string_format(
006357:                         builder->arena, S8("C IR lowering does not support an atomic {S8} of a {u64}-byte aggregate: this target has no lock-free access that wide"),
006358:                         instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD ? S8("load") : S8("store"),
006359:                         qualified && qualified->layout.resolved ? qualified->layout.size : 0);
006360:                     builder->failure_token_index = UINT32_MAX;
006361:                     supported = false;
006362:                 }
006363:             }
006364:             instruction_id = instruction->next;
006365:         }
006366:     }
006367: 
006368:     return supported;
006369: }

006384: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_required(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId atomic_type)
006385: {
006386:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, atomic_type);
006387:     return type && type->is_atomic && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == 16 &&
006388:            builder->target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_X86_64 &&
006389:            !target_cpu_feature_has(builder->target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_CX16);
006390: }
006391: 
006392: // The type-specific libatomic entry points erase the C object's signedness,
006393: // atomic/volatile qualifiers and aggregate spelling at their ABI boundary.
006394: // Use one unsigned bit representation and one plain pointer type so every
006395: // source spelling in a translation unit reuses exactly one imported symbol.
006396: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_arguments(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId atomic_type,
006397:                                                            IrSourceRange source, IrTypeId* bits_type_out, IrTypeId* pointer_type_out,
006398:                                                            IrValueId* address_out)
006399: {
006400:     IrTypeId bits_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128);
006401:     IrValueId bits_place = bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006402:                                ? c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_place(builder, place, atomic_type, bits_type, source)
006403:                                : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006404:     IrTypeId bits_place_type = bits_place.value < builder->function->value_count
006405:                                    ? builder->function->values[bits_place.value].canonical_type
006406:                                    : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006407:     IrValueId qualified_address = bits_place_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006408:                                       ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, bits_place, bits_place_type, source)
006409:                                       : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006410:     IrTypeId pointer_type = bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006411:                                 ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, bits_type)
006412:                                 : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006413:     IrValueId address = qualified_address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006414:                             ? c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, qualified_address, pointer_type,
006415:                                                          IR_CONVERSION_POINTER_REINTERPRET, source)
006416:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006417:     bool valid = bits_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
006418:                  address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
006419:     if (!valid && !builder->failure_message.length)
006420:     {
006421:         builder->failure_message = S8("could not form a canonical address for a 16-byte atomic runtime call");
006422:     }
006423:     if (valid)
006424:     {
006425:         *bits_type_out = bits_type;
006426:         *pointer_type_out = pointer_type;
006427:         *address_out = address;
006428:     }
006429:     return valid;
006430: }

006432: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_wide_atomic_runtime_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId atomic_type,
006433:                                                                 IrSourceRange source, IrMemoryOrder order)
006434: {
006435:     IrType* atomic = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, atomic_type);
006436:     IrTypeId value_type = atomic ? atomic->unqualified_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006437:     IrType* value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
006438:     bool aggregate = value && (value->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || value->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION);
006439:     IrTypeId bits_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006440:     IrTypeId pointer_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006441:     IrValueId address = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006442:     IrValueId order_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, (u64)order, false, (CToken){0}, builder->s32_type);
006443:     IrTypeId parameter_types[2] = {IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID, builder->s32_type};
006444:     IrValueId arguments[2] = {IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID, order_value};
006445:     IrValueId loaded = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006446:     bool emitted = c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_arguments(builder, place, atomic_type, source, &bits_type, &pointer_type, &address);
006447:     parameter_types[0] = pointer_type;
006448:     arguments[0] = address;
006449:     emitted = emitted && order_value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
006450:               c_ir_emit_runtime_call_source(builder, source, S8("__atomic_load_16"), bits_type,
006451:                                             parameter_types, arguments, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(arguments), &loaded);
006452:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006453:     if (emitted)
006454:     {
006455:         result = aggregate ? c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_value(builder, loaded, value_type, bits_type, false, source)
006456:                            : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, loaded, value_type, source);
006457:     }
006458:     else
006459:     {
006460:         if (!builder->failure_message.length)
006461:         {
006462:             builder->failure_message = S8("could not emit a 16-byte atomic runtime load");
006463:         }
006464:     }
006465:     if (result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && !builder->failure_message.length)
006466:     {
006467:         builder->failure_message = S8("could not convert a 16-byte atomic runtime load result");
006468:     }
006469:     return result;
006470: }

006498: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_memory_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIntegerIrLocal* local, CToken token)
006499: {
006500:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, local->type);
006501:     bool atomic = place_type && place_type->is_atomic;
006502:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;

006577: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_binary_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId left, IrValueId right, IrTypeId type, IrBinaryOperation operation,
006578:                                                      IrSourceRange source)
006579: {
006580:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006581:     IrTypeId left_type = left.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[left.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006582:     IrTypeId right_type = right.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[right.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006583:     bool binary16_operands = c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, left_type) && c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, right_type);
006584:     bool arithmetic = operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY ||
006585:                       operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE;
006586:     bool comparison = operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS ||
006587:                       operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL;
006588:     if (binary16_operands && (arithmetic || comparison))
006589:     {
006590:         IrValueId left_wide = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, left, left_type, source);
006591:         IrValueId right_wide = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, right, right_type, source);
006592:         if (left_wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && right_wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006593:         {
006594:             IrValueId wide_result = c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(builder, left_wide, right_wide, comparison ? type : builder->f32_type, operation, source);
006595:             if (comparison)
006596:             {
006597:                 result = wide_result;
006598:             }
006599:             else if (wide_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006600:             {
006601:                 result = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__truncsfhf2"), type, wide_result, builder->f32_type, source);
006602:             }
006603:         }
006604:     }
006605:     else
006606:     {
006607:         result = c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(builder, left, right, type, operation, source);
006608:     }
006609:     return result;
006610: }

006734: // The address of the bytes a bit-field occupies, as `unsigned char*`.
006735: // `c_ir_emit_address_of_place` refuses a bit-field place because C does --
006736: // `&s.b` is not an expression -- but a field with no single storage unit is
006737: // read and written one piece at a time, and the pieces past the first are
006738: // bytes the member place cannot name. The place still starts at
006739: // `field->offset`, which is the first byte of the span.
006740: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrSourceRange source)
006741: {
006742:     IrTypeId place_type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
006743:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, place_type);
006744:     IrTypeId byte_pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR));
006745:     if (pointer_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || byte_pointer_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006746:     {
006747:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006748:     }
006749:     IrValueId address = c_ir_add_result(builder, pointer_type);
006750:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006751:     {
006752:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006753:     }
006754:     builder->function->values[address.value].points_to_read_only = builder->function->values[place.value].is_read_only;
006755:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF, pointer_type);
006756:     instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
006757:     instruction.operands[0] = place;
006758:     instruction.operand_count = 1;
006759:     instruction.result = address;
006760:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
006761:     builder->function->values[address.value].definition = id;
006762:     return c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, byte_pointer_type, source);
006763: }

006784: // The bits of `field` that lie in one piece of its span, as the half-open
006785: // range [`low`, `high`) of span bit positions. Empty when the piece holds none
006786: // of them, which no piece of a span that is exactly the field's bytes does,
006787: // but a caller that walks pieces should not have to know that.
006788: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(IrField const* field, IrFieldAccessPiece piece, u32* low, u32* high)
006789: {
006790:     u32 piece_low = (u32)piece.offset * 8;
006791:     u32 piece_high = piece_low + (u32)piece.size * 8;
006792:     u32 field_high = field->bit_offset + field->bit_width;
006793:     *low = BUSTER_MAX(piece_low, field->bit_offset);
006794:     *high = BUSTER_MIN(piece_high, field_high);
006795: }
006796: 
006797: // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no single storage unit for is read one
006798: // piece at a time and reassembled: each piece contributes the bits of its own
006799: // byte range that belong to the field, shifted down to the field's low bit.
006800: // The assembly runs at sixty-four bits, which covers every bit-field there is,
006801: // and the result narrows to the declared type on the way out -- the same shape
006802: // the single-unit extraction has, with the load replaced by a sum of loads.
006803: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrField* field, IrTypeId type, u64 access_size,
006804:                                                            IrSourceRange source)
006805: {
006806:     IrFieldAccessPiece pieces[IR_FIELD_ACCESS_PIECE_CAPACITY];
006807:     u32 piece_count = ir_field_access_pieces(access_size, pieces);
006808:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006809:     IrTypeId wide_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, 8);
006810:     IrValueId address = piece_count && value_type && wide_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006811:                             ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(builder, place, source)
006812:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006813:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006814:     {
006815:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006816:     }
006817:     CToken token = {0};
006818:     IrValueId assembled = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006819:     for (u32 index = 0; index < piece_count; index += 1)
006820:     {
006821:         u32 low = 0;
006822:         u32 high = 0;
006823:         c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(field, pieces[index], &low, &high);
006824:         if (low >= high)
006825:         {
006826:             continue;
006827:         }
006828:         IrTypeId piece_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, pieces[index].size);
006829:         IrValueId piece_place =
006830:             piece_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_piece_place(builder, address, pieces[index].offset, piece_type, source)
006831:                                                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006832:         IrValueId loaded = piece_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, piece_place, piece_type, source)
006833:                                                                         : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006834:         IrValueId part = loaded.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, loaded, wide_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006835:         if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006836:         {
006837:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006838:         }
006839:         if (low > (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8)
006840:         {
006841:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8, false, token, wide_type);
006842:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
006843:         }
006844:         u64 mask = high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1;
006845:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, wide_type);
006846:         part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, mask_value, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
006847:         if (low > field->bit_offset)
006848:         {
006849:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - field->bit_offset, false, token, wide_type);
006850:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
006851:         }
006852:         assembled = assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006853:                         ? part
006854:                         : c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, part, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR, source);
006855:         if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006856:         {
006857:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006858:         }
006859:     }
006860:     if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006861:     {
006862:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006863:     }
006864:     // The sign lives at the field's own top bit, so it is stretched from
006865:     // there rather than from the assembly width; an unsigned field already
006866:     // has zeroes above it from the masks.
006867:     if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < 64)
006868:     {
006869:         IrTypeId signed_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_LONG_LONG);
006870:         IrType* signed_value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, signed_type);

006872:         {
006873:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006874:         }

006876:         assembled = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, assembled, signed_type, source);
006877:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
006878:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
006879:     }

006882:     return result;

006784: // The bits of `field` that lie in one piece of its span, as the half-open
006785: // range [`low`, `high`) of span bit positions. Empty when the piece holds none
006786: // of them, which no piece of a span that is exactly the field's bytes does,
006787: // but a caller that walks pieces should not have to know that.
006788: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(IrField const* field, IrFieldAccessPiece piece, u32* low, u32* high)
006789: {
006790:     u32 piece_low = (u32)piece.offset * 8;
006791:     u32 piece_high = piece_low + (u32)piece.size * 8;
006792:     u32 field_high = field->bit_offset + field->bit_width;
006793:     *low = BUSTER_MAX(piece_low, field->bit_offset);
006794:     *high = BUSTER_MIN(piece_high, field_high);
006795: }

006797: // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no single storage unit for is read one
006798: // piece at a time and reassembled: each piece contributes the bits of its own
006799: // byte range that belong to the field, shifted down to the field's low bit.
006800: // The assembly runs at sixty-four bits, which covers every bit-field there is,
006801: // and the result narrows to the declared type on the way out -- the same shape
006802: // the single-unit extraction has, with the load replaced by a sum of loads.

006804:                                                            IrSourceRange source)

006815:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;

006825:         {

006791:     u32 piece_high = piece_low + (u32)piece.size * 8;
006792:     u32 field_high = field->bit_offset + field->bit_width;
006793:     *low = BUSTER_MAX(piece_low, field->bit_offset);
006794:     *high = BUSTER_MIN(piece_high, field_high);
006795: }
006796: 
006797: // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no single storage unit for is read one
006798: // piece at a time and reassembled: each piece contributes the bits of its own
006799: // byte range that belong to the field, shifted down to the field's low bit.
006800: // The assembly runs at sixty-four bits, which covers every bit-field there is,
006801: // and the result narrows to the declared type on the way out -- the same shape
006802: // the single-unit extraction has, with the load replaced by a sum of loads.
006803: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrField* field, IrTypeId type, u64 access_size,
006804:                                                            IrSourceRange source)
006805: {
006806:     IrFieldAccessPiece pieces[IR_FIELD_ACCESS_PIECE_CAPACITY];
006807:     u32 piece_count = ir_field_access_pieces(access_size, pieces);
006808:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006809:     IrTypeId wide_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, 8);
006810:     IrValueId address = piece_count && value_type && wide_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006811:                             ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(builder, place, source)
006812:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006813:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006814:     {
006815:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006816:     }
006817:     CToken token = {0};
006818:     IrValueId assembled = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006819:     for (u32 index = 0; index < piece_count; index += 1)
006820:     {
006821:         u32 low = 0;
006822:         u32 high = 0;
006823:         c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(field, pieces[index], &low, &high);
006824:         if (low >= high)
006825:         {
006826:             continue;
006827:         }
006828:         IrTypeId piece_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, pieces[index].size);
006829:         IrValueId piece_place =
006830:             piece_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_piece_place(builder, address, pieces[index].offset, piece_type, source)
006831:                                                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006832:         IrValueId loaded = piece_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, piece_place, piece_type, source)
006833:                                                                         : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006834:         IrValueId part = loaded.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, loaded, wide_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006835:         if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006836:         {
006837:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006838:         }
006839:         if (low > (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8)
006840:         {
006841:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8, false, token, wide_type);
006842:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
006843:         }
006844:         u64 mask = high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1;
006845:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, wide_type);
006846:         part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, mask_value, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
006847:         if (low > field->bit_offset)
006848:         {
006849:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - field->bit_offset, false, token, wide_type);
006850:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
006851:         }
006852:         assembled = assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006853:                         ? part
006854:                         : c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, part, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR, source);
006855:         if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006856:         {
006857:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006858:         }
006859:     }
006860:     if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006861:     {
006862:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006863:     }
006864:     // The sign lives at the field's own top bit, so it is stretched from
006865:     // there rather than from the assembly width; an unsigned field already
006866:     // has zeroes above it from the masks.
006867:     if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < 64)
006868:     {
006869:         IrTypeId signed_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_LONG_LONG);
006870:         IrType* signed_value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, signed_type);
006871:         if (!signed_value_type || signed_value_type->bit_width != 64)
006872:         {
006873:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006874:         }
006875:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 64 - field->bit_width, false, token, signed_type);
006876:         assembled = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, assembled, signed_type, source);
006877:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
006878:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
006879:     }
006880:     IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, assembled, type, source);
006881:     c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, result, field);
006882:     return result;
006883: }

006886: // the field's and takes the field's from the value. A piece the field fills
006887: // completely needs no read at all.

006962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
006963: {
006964:     // C 6.3.2.1p4: a function designator is converted to a pointer to the
006965:     // function; there is nothing to load out of one. The place reaches here
006966:     // when the name resolves to an entity rather than to a call — a
006967:     // block-scope `extern void sighandler(int);` declares such a name, and
006968:     // sbase's make then stores it in a `struct sigaction`.
006969:     IrType* designated_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006970:     if (designated_type && designated_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
006971:     {
006972:         return c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
006973:     }
006974:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
006975:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006976:     // A `_Bool` bit-field's bits are extracted like any other's. Its declared
006977:     // type is not an integer, so the extraction used to be skipped and the
006978:     // whole `_Bool` unit came back -- every neighbouring field's bits with it,
006979:     // normalized to one, which is why a `_Bool` that happened to be the only
006980:     // set bit still read correctly. The unit it is read through has to be an
006981:     // integer of the same width for the shift to see the raw byte.
006982:     bool boolean = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
006983:     bool extract =
006984:         field && value_type && (value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || boolean) && field->bit_width && field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width;
006985:     // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no room for a declared-type unit
006986:     // of is read through the narrower one its layout recorded; every other

006885: // The write half of the same split: every piece keeps the bits that are not
006886: // the field's and takes the field's from the value. A piece the field fills
006887: // completely needs no read at all.

006889:                                                        IrSourceRange source)
006890: {

006938:         }

006962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
006963: {
006964:     // C 6.3.2.1p4: a function designator is converted to a pointer to the
006965:     // function; there is nothing to load out of one. The place reaches here
006966:     // when the name resolves to an entity rather than to a call — a
006967:     // block-scope `extern void sighandler(int);` declares such a name, and
006968:     // sbase's make then stores it in a `struct sigaction`.
006969:     IrType* designated_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006970:     if (designated_type && designated_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
006971:     {
006972:         return c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
006973:     }
006974:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
006975:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006976:     // A `_Bool` bit-field's bits are extracted like any other's. Its declared
006977:     // type is not an integer, so the extraction used to be skipped and the
006978:     // whole `_Bool` unit came back -- every neighbouring field's bits with it,
006979:     // normalized to one, which is why a `_Bool` that happened to be the only
006980:     // set bit still read correctly. The unit it is read through has to be an
006981:     // integer of the same width for the shift to see the raw byte.
006982:     bool boolean = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
006983:     bool extract =
006984:         field && value_type && (value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || boolean) && field->bit_width && field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width;
006985:     // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no room for a declared-type unit
006986:     // of is read through the narrower one its layout recorded; every other
006987:     // field reads its own type. A span that is no integer's width -- five
006988:     // bytes for `long long b : 40` -- has no such unit and takes several
006989:     // accesses instead.
006990:     IrTypeId access_type = type;
006991:     if (extract && (field->access_size || boolean))
006992:     {
006993:         access_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, ir_field_access_size(&builder->program->types, field));
006994:         if (access_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006995:         {
006996:             return c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(builder, place, field, type, field->access_size, source);
006997:         }
006998:     }
006999:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, access_type, source);
007000:     if (extract)
007001:     {
007002:         CToken token = {0};
007003:         // The extraction runs in the promoted type, never in a narrower one:
007004:         // the machine backends model shifts at 32 and 64 bits only, so a
007005:         // 16-bit `shl`/`sar` pair executes at 32 bits and the sign bit of a
007006:         // `short a : 9` never reaches the top. Promoting here is also what C
007007:         // does with the value, and the result narrows back on the way out.
007008:         // The memory load removes object qualifiers. Extraction and its
007009:         // constants must use that same value type, including volatile fields.
007010:         IrTypeId result_type = value_type->is_atomic || value_type->is_volatile ? value_type->unqualified_type : type;
007011:         IrTypeId extract_type = result_type;
007012:         IrType* extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007013:         if (value_type->bit_width < 32)
007014:         {
007015:             extract_type = value_type->is_signed ? builder->s32_type : builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT];
007016:             extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007017:         }
007018:         if (extract_type_value && extract_type.value != access_type.value)
007019:         {
007020:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, extract_type, source);
007021:         }
007022:         if (!extract_type_value || value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
007023:         {
007024:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
007025:         }
007026:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, field->bit_offset, false, token, extract_type);
007027:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shift, extract_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007028:         u64 mask = field->bit_width == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << field->bit_width) - 1;
007029:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, extract_type);
007030:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, mask_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
007031:         if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < extract_type_value->bit_width)
007032:         {
007033:             u32 sign_shift = extract_type_value->bit_width - field->bit_width;
007034:             IrValueId sign_shift_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, sign_shift, false, token, extract_type);
007035:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
007036:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007037:         }
007038:         if (extract_type.value != result_type.value)
007039:         {
007040:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, result_type, source);
007041:         }
007042:         c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, value, field);
007043:     }

006885: // The write half of the same split: every piece keeps the bits that are not
006886: // the field's and takes the field's from the value. A piece the field fills

006889:                                                        IrSourceRange source)
006890: {

006962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
006963: {
006964:     // C 6.3.2.1p4: a function designator is converted to a pointer to the
006965:     // function; there is nothing to load out of one. The place reaches here
006966:     // when the name resolves to an entity rather than to a call — a
006967:     // block-scope `extern void sighandler(int);` declares such a name, and
006968:     // sbase's make then stores it in a `struct sigaction`.
006969:     IrType* designated_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006970:     if (designated_type && designated_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
006971:     {
006972:         return c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
006973:     }
006974:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
006975:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006976:     // A `_Bool` bit-field's bits are extracted like any other's. Its declared
006977:     // type is not an integer, so the extraction used to be skipped and the
006978:     // whole `_Bool` unit came back -- every neighbouring field's bits with it,
006979:     // normalized to one, which is why a `_Bool` that happened to be the only
006980:     // set bit still read correctly. The unit it is read through has to be an
006981:     // integer of the same width for the shift to see the raw byte.
006982:     bool boolean = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
006983:     bool extract =
006984:         field && value_type && (value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || boolean) && field->bit_width && field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width;
006985:     // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no room for a declared-type unit
006986:     // of is read through the narrower one its layout recorded; every other
006987:     // field reads its own type. A span that is no integer's width -- five
006988:     // bytes for `long long b : 40` -- has no such unit and takes several
006989:     // accesses instead.
006990:     IrTypeId access_type = type;
006991:     if (extract && (field->access_size || boolean))
006992:     {
006993:         access_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, ir_field_access_size(&builder->program->types, field));
006994:         if (access_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006995:         {
006996:             return c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(builder, place, field, type, field->access_size, source);
006997:         }
006998:     }
006999:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, access_type, source);
007000:     if (extract)
007001:     {
007002:         CToken token = {0};
007003:         // The extraction runs in the promoted type, never in a narrower one:
007004:         // the machine backends model shifts at 32 and 64 bits only, so a
007005:         // 16-bit `shl`/`sar` pair executes at 32 bits and the sign bit of a
007006:         // `short a : 9` never reaches the top. Promoting here is also what C
007007:         // does with the value, and the result narrows back on the way out.
007008:         // The memory load removes object qualifiers. Extraction and its
007009:         // constants must use that same value type, including volatile fields.
007010:         IrTypeId result_type = value_type->is_atomic || value_type->is_volatile ? value_type->unqualified_type : type;
007011:         IrTypeId extract_type = result_type;
007012:         IrType* extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007013:         if (value_type->bit_width < 32)
007014:         {
007015:             extract_type = value_type->is_signed ? builder->s32_type : builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT];
007016:             extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007017:         }
007018:         if (extract_type_value && extract_type.value != access_type.value)
007019:         {
007020:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, extract_type, source);
007021:         }
007022:         if (!extract_type_value || value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
007023:         {
007024:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
007025:         }
007026:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, field->bit_offset, false, token, extract_type);
007027:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shift, extract_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007028:         u64 mask = field->bit_width == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << field->bit_width) - 1;
007029:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, extract_type);
007030:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, mask_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
007031:         if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < extract_type_value->bit_width)
007032:         {
007033:             u32 sign_shift = extract_type_value->bit_width - field->bit_width;
007034:             IrValueId sign_shift_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, sign_shift, false, token, extract_type);
007035:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
007036:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007037:         }
007038:         if (extract_type.value != result_type.value)
007039:         {
007040:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, result_type, source);
007041:         }
007042:         c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, value, field);
007043:     }
007044: 
007045:     return value;
007046: }

006962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
006963: {
006964:     // C 6.3.2.1p4: a function designator is converted to a pointer to the
006965:     // function; there is nothing to load out of one. The place reaches here
006966:     // when the name resolves to an entity rather than to a call — a
006967:     // block-scope `extern void sighandler(int);` declares such a name, and
006968:     // sbase's make then stores it in a `struct sigaction`.
006969:     IrType* designated_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006970:     if (designated_type && designated_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
006971:     {
006972:         return c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
006973:     }
006974:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
006975:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006976:     // A `_Bool` bit-field's bits are extracted like any other's. Its declared
006977:     // type is not an integer, so the extraction used to be skipped and the
006978:     // whole `_Bool` unit came back -- every neighbouring field's bits with it,
006979:     // normalized to one, which is why a `_Bool` that happened to be the only
006980:     // set bit still read correctly. The unit it is read through has to be an
006981:     // integer of the same width for the shift to see the raw byte.
006982:     bool boolean = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
006983:     bool extract =
006984:         field && value_type && (value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || boolean) && field->bit_width && field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width;
006985:     // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no room for a declared-type unit
006986:     // of is read through the narrower one its layout recorded; every other
006987:     // field reads its own type. A span that is no integer's width -- five
006988:     // bytes for `long long b : 40` -- has no such unit and takes several
006989:     // accesses instead.
006990:     IrTypeId access_type = type;
006991:     if (extract && (field->access_size || boolean))
006992:     {
006993:         access_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, ir_field_access_size(&builder->program->types, field));
006994:         if (access_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006995:         {
006996:             return c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(builder, place, field, type, field->access_size, source);
006997:         }
006998:     }
006999:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, access_type, source);
007000:     if (extract)
007001:     {
007002:         CToken token = {0};
007003:         // The extraction runs in the promoted type, never in a narrower one:
007004:         // the machine backends model shifts at 32 and 64 bits only, so a
007005:         // 16-bit `shl`/`sar` pair executes at 32 bits and the sign bit of a
007006:         // `short a : 9` never reaches the top. Promoting here is also what C
007007:         // does with the value, and the result narrows back on the way out.
007008:         // The memory load removes object qualifiers. Extraction and its
007009:         // constants must use that same value type, including volatile fields.
007010:         IrTypeId result_type = value_type->is_atomic || value_type->is_volatile ? value_type->unqualified_type : type;
007011:         IrTypeId extract_type = result_type;
007012:         IrType* extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007013:         if (value_type->bit_width < 32)
007014:         {
007015:             extract_type = value_type->is_signed ? builder->s32_type : builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT];
007016:             extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007017:         }
007018:         if (extract_type_value && extract_type.value != access_type.value)
007019:         {
007020:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, extract_type, source);
007021:         }
007022:         if (!extract_type_value || value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
007023:         {
007024:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
007025:         }
007026:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, field->bit_offset, false, token, extract_type);
007027:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shift, extract_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007028:         u64 mask = field->bit_width == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << field->bit_width) - 1;
007029:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, extract_type);
007030:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, mask_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
007031:         if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < extract_type_value->bit_width)
007032:         {
007033:             u32 sign_shift = extract_type_value->bit_width - field->bit_width;
007034:             IrValueId sign_shift_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, sign_shift, false, token, extract_type);
007035:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
007036:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007037:         }
007038:         if (extract_type.value != result_type.value)
007039:         {
007040:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, result_type, source);
007041:         }
007042:         c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, value, field);
007043:     }
007044: 
007045:     return value;
007046: }

007067: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_place_may_have_static_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place)
007068: {
007069:     u32 value = place.value;
007070:     u32 steps = builder->function->value_count + 1;
007071:     while (value < builder->function->value_count && steps)
007072:     {
007073:         steps -= 1;
007074:         IrValue* current = builder->function->values + value;
007075:         IrInstructionId definition = current->definition;
007076:         if (definition.value >= builder->function->instruction_count)
007077:         {
007078:             return true;
007079:         }
007080:         IrInstruction* instruction = builder->function->instructions + definition.value;
007081:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL)
007082:         {
007083:             return true;
007084:         }
007085:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOCAL)
007086:         {
007087:             return false;
007088:         }
007089:         if ((instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FIELD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_INDEX || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE ||
007090:              instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_CAST) &&
007091:             instruction->operand_count >= 1 && instruction->operands)
007092:         {
007093:             value = instruction->operands[0].value;
007094:             continue;
007095:         }
007096:         return true;
007097:     }
007098:     return true;
007099: }

007104: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrConversionOperation operation,
007105:                                                          IrSourceRange source)
007106: {
007107:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count && c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, value))
007108:     {

007111:         bool original_void_pointer = source_value && destination_value && source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && destination_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER &&
007112:                                      source_value->element_type.value == destination_value->element_type.value &&
007113:                                      source_value->element_type.value < builder->program->types.count &&
007114:                                      ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, source_value->element_type)->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID &&
007115:                                      source_value->id.value == destination_value->id.value;

007117:         {
007118:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label-provenance value may only be used with its original void pointer type");
007119:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
007120:         }
007121:     }
007122:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, target_type);
007123:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
007124:     {
007125:         // A pointer reinterpretation takes the target type's own
007126:         // qualification, and IR types carry no const: the flag clears, so
007127:         // `((char *)formatted)[size-1] = '\0'` -- CPython casting away the
007128:         // const its own accessor returned -- stores where the reference
007129:         // compilers store.  The cost is one diagnostic, not a miscompile: a
007130:         // cast that *adds* const is no longer refused as a store target,
007131:         // which is the same laxity the reference compilers only warn about
007132:         // under -Wcast-qual.  Stores through const lvalues keep their
007133:         // refusal -- those places read their entity's own C type.
007134:         builder->function->values[result.value].points_to_read_only =
007135:             operation != IR_CONVERSION_POINTER_REINTERPRET && builder->function->values[value.value].points_to_read_only;
007136:         c_ir_copy_label_provenance(builder, result, value);
007137:     }
007138:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
007139:     operands[0] = value;
007140:     IrSourceRange cast_source = source;
007141:     IrInstruction cast = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CAST, target_type);
007142:     cast.operands = operands;
007143:     cast.operand_count = 1;
007144:     cast.conversion_operation = (u8)operation;
007145:     cast.result = result;
007146:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, cast, cast_source);

007084:         }
007085:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOCAL)
007086:         {
007087:             return false;
007088:         }
007089:         if ((instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FIELD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_INDEX || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE ||
007090:              instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_CAST) &&
007091:             instruction->operand_count >= 1 && instruction->operands)
007092:         {

007094:             continue;
007095:         }
007096:         return true;
007097:     }
007098:     return true;

007104: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrConversionOperation operation,
007105:                                                          IrSourceRange source)
007106: {
007107:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count && c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, value))
007108:     {
007109:         IrType* source_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
007110:         IrType* destination_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target_type);
007111:         bool original_void_pointer = source_value && destination_value && source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && destination_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER &&
007112:                                      source_value->element_type.value == destination_value->element_type.value &&
007113:                                      source_value->element_type.value < builder->program->types.count &&
007114:                                      ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, source_value->element_type)->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID &&
007115:                                      source_value->id.value == destination_value->id.value;
007116:         if (!original_void_pointer)
007117:         {
007118:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label-provenance value may only be used with its original void pointer type");
007119:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
007120:         }
007121:     }
007122:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, target_type);
007123:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
007124:     {
007125:         // A pointer reinterpretation takes the target type's own
007126:         // qualification, and IR types carry no const: the flag clears, so
007127:         // `((char *)formatted)[size-1] = '\0'` -- CPython casting away the
007128:         // const its own accessor returned -- stores where the reference
007129:         // compilers store.  The cost is one diagnostic, not a miscompile: a
007130:         // cast that *adds* const is no longer refused as a store target,
007131:         // which is the same laxity the reference compilers only warn about
007132:         // under -Wcast-qual.  Stores through const lvalues keep their
007133:         // refusal -- those places read their entity's own C type.
007134:         builder->function->values[result.value].points_to_read_only =
007135:             operation != IR_CONVERSION_POINTER_REINTERPRET && builder->function->values[value.value].points_to_read_only;
007136:         c_ir_copy_label_provenance(builder, result, value);
007137:     }
007138:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
007139:     operands[0] = value;
007140:     IrSourceRange cast_source = source;
007141:     IrInstruction cast = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CAST, target_type);
007142:     cast.operands = operands;
007143:     cast.operand_count = 1;
007144:     cast.conversion_operation = (u8)operation;
007145:     cast.result = result;
007146:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, cast, cast_source);
007147:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
007148:     return result;
007149: }

006962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
006963: {
006964:     // C 6.3.2.1p4: a function designator is converted to a pointer to the
006965:     // function; there is nothing to load out of one. The place reaches here
006966:     // when the name resolves to an entity rather than to a call — a
006967:     // block-scope `extern void sighandler(int);` declares such a name, and
006968:     // sbase's make then stores it in a `struct sigaction`.
006969:     IrType* designated_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006970:     if (designated_type && designated_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
006971:     {
006972:         return c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
006973:     }
006974:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
006975:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006976:     // A `_Bool` bit-field's bits are extracted like any other's. Its declared
006977:     // type is not an integer, so the extraction used to be skipped and the
006978:     // whole `_Bool` unit came back -- every neighbouring field's bits with it,
006979:     // normalized to one, which is why a `_Bool` that happened to be the only
006980:     // set bit still read correctly. The unit it is read through has to be an
006981:     // integer of the same width for the shift to see the raw byte.
006982:     bool boolean = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
006983:     bool extract =
006984:         field && value_type && (value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || boolean) && field->bit_width && field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width;
006985:     // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no room for a declared-type unit
006986:     // of is read through the narrower one its layout recorded; every other
006987:     // field reads its own type. A span that is no integer's width -- five
006988:     // bytes for `long long b : 40` -- has no such unit and takes several
006989:     // accesses instead.
006990:     IrTypeId access_type = type;
006991:     if (extract && (field->access_size || boolean))
006992:     {
006993:         access_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, ir_field_access_size(&builder->program->types, field));
006994:         if (access_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006995:         {
006996:             return c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(builder, place, field, type, field->access_size, source);
006997:         }
006998:     }
006999:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, access_type, source);
007000:     if (extract)
007001:     {
007002:         CToken token = {0};
007003:         // The extraction runs in the promoted type, never in a narrower one:
007004:         // the machine backends model shifts at 32 and 64 bits only, so a
007005:         // 16-bit `shl`/`sar` pair executes at 32 bits and the sign bit of a
007006:         // `short a : 9` never reaches the top. Promoting here is also what C
007007:         // does with the value, and the result narrows back on the way out.
007008:         // The memory load removes object qualifiers. Extraction and its
007009:         // constants must use that same value type, including volatile fields.
007010:         IrTypeId result_type = value_type->is_atomic || value_type->is_volatile ? value_type->unqualified_type : type;
007011:         IrTypeId extract_type = result_type;
007012:         IrType* extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007013:         if (value_type->bit_width < 32)
007014:         {
007015:             extract_type = value_type->is_signed ? builder->s32_type : builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT];
007016:             extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
007017:         }
007018:         if (extract_type_value && extract_type.value != access_type.value)
007019:         {
007020:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, extract_type, source);
007021:         }
007022:         if (!extract_type_value || value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
007023:         {
007024:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
007025:         }
007026:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, field->bit_offset, false, token, extract_type);
007027:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shift, extract_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007028:         u64 mask = field->bit_width == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << field->bit_width) - 1;
007029:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, extract_type);
007030:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, mask_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
007031:         if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < extract_type_value->bit_width)
007032:         {
007033:             u32 sign_shift = extract_type_value->bit_width - field->bit_width;
007034:             IrValueId sign_shift_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, sign_shift, false, token, extract_type);
007035:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
007036:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
007037:         }
007038:         if (extract_type.value != result_type.value)
007039:         {
007040:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, result_type, source);
007041:         }
007042:         c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, value, field);
007043:     }
007044: 
007045:     return value;
007046: }

007048: // An assignment expression names the stored field value. Keep its promotion
007049: // fact without rereading memory (in particular, without a second volatile load).
007050: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_bit_field_assignment_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
007051: {
007052:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
007053:     IrValueId result = value;
007054:     if (c_ir_unsigned_bit_field_promotes_to_int(builder, field))
007055:     {
007056:         result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, field->type, source);
007057:         if (result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
007058:         {
007059:             IrValueId mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, ((u64)1 << field->bit_width) - 1, false, (CToken){0}, field->type);
007060:             result = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, result, mask, field->type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
007061:             c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, result, field);
007062:         }
007063:     }
007064:     return result;
007065: }

007067: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_place_may_have_static_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place)
007068: {
007069:     u32 value = place.value;
007070:     u32 steps = builder->function->value_count + 1;
007071:     while (value < builder->function->value_count && steps)
007072:     {
007073:         steps -= 1;
007074:         IrValue* current = builder->function->values + value;
007075:         IrInstructionId definition = current->definition;
007076:         if (definition.value >= builder->function->instruction_count)
007077:         {
007078:             return true;
007079:         }
007080:         IrInstruction* instruction = builder->function->instructions + definition.value;
007081:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL)
007082:         {
007083:             return true;
007084:         }
007085:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOCAL)
007086:         {
007087:             return false;
007088:         }
007089:         if ((instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FIELD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_INDEX || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE ||
007090:              instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_CAST) &&
007091:             instruction->operand_count >= 1 && instruction->operands)
007092:         {
007093:             value = instruction->operands[0].value;
007094:             continue;
007095:         }
007096:         return true;
007097:     }
007098:     return true;
007099: }

007126:         // qualification, and IR types carry no const: the flag clears, so
007127:         // `((char *)formatted)[size-1] = '\0'` -- CPython casting away the
007128:         // const its own accessor returned -- stores where the reference
007129:         // compilers store.  The cost is one diagnostic, not a miscompile: a
007130:         // cast that *adds* const is no longer refused as a store target,

007139:     operands[0] = value;

007142:     cast.operands = operands;
007143:     cast.operand_count = 1;
007144:     cast.conversion_operation = (u8)operation;

007147:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;

007174: // with it) reaches pointer width first, sign-extending when the operand is

007765: // Do two types agree closely enough that a function prototype built from them
007766: // is the same prototype? Identical ids always do. Beyond that only the coarse
007767: // shape is compared -- the kind, and for the scalar kinds the width and
007768: // signedness -- because two spellings of one aggregate can reach here as two
007769: // ids and refusing them would reject valid code. This is the deliberate
007770: // conservatism c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible documents.
007771: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left, IrTypeId right)
007772: {
007773:     IrType* left_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left);
007774:     IrType* right_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right);
007775:     bool result = left.value == right.value;
007776:     if (!result && left_type && right_type && left_type->kind == right_type->kind)
007777:     {
007778:         result = left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT && left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
007779:         result = result || (left_type->bit_width == right_type->bit_width && left_type->is_signed == right_type->is_signed &&
007780:                             (left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT || left_type->float_format == right_type->float_format));
007781:     }
007782: 
007783:     return result;
007784: }
007785: 
007786: // Whether a value may cross into an object of `target` without a cast, for the
007787: // one class C makes an error of that this frontend used to accept in silence:
007788: // two pointers to functions whose prototypes disagree (#830). Clang has made it
007789: // an error by default since Clang 16 and GCC diagnoses it too, and the silence
007790: // flipped autoconf probes that read the diagnostic as their answer -- CPython's
007791: // readline check assigns `int(const char*, int)` to an `int(*)(void)` and
007792: // concludes from the refusal that the hook takes no arguments.
007793: //
007794: // Only a mismatch both reference compilers reject is reported, and only when
007795: // both sides are function pointers: a `void*` on either side is the idiom every
007796: // dispatch table is built from, and an unprototyped `()` is compatible with a
007797: // non-variadic prototype by C11 6.2.7p3 -- musl's `long __syscall_cp_asm();`
007798: // beside its eight-parameter prototype is one function, not two. Within that,
007799: // the parameter count, the variadic-ness, and the kind (and scalar width) of
007800: // the return and of each parameter have to agree. Anything subtler is accepted:
007801: // a false refusal would reject a translation unit clang compiles, which is a
007802: // worse failure than the silence this replaces.
007803: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left, IrTypeId right)
007804: {
007805:     IrType* left_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left);
007806:     IrType* right_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right);
007807:     bool result = true;
007808:     if (left.value != right.value && left_type && right_type && left_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION && right_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION &&
007809:         !left_type->is_unprototyped && !right_type->is_unprototyped)
007810:     {
007811:         result = left_type->parameter_count == right_type->parameter_count && left_type->is_variadic == right_type->is_variadic &&
007812:                  c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(builder, left_type->return_type, right_type->return_type);
007813:         for (u32 index = 0; result && index < left_type->parameter_count; index += 1)
007814:         {
007815:             result = c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(builder, left_type->parameter_types[index], right_type->parameter_types[index]);
007816:         }
007817:     }
007818: 
007819:     return result;
007820: }
007821: 
007822: // The pointer wrapper around c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible: an
007823: // assignment crosses two *pointers*, and only when both point at functions is
007824: // there a prototype to compare.
007825: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_pointer_assignment_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId target, IrTypeId source)
007826: {
007827:     IrType* target_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target);
007828:     IrType* source_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, source);
007829:     bool result = true;
007830:     if (target_type && source_type && target_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && source_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
007831:     {
007832:         result = c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible(builder, target_type->element_type, source_type->element_type);
007833:     }
007834: 
007835:     return result;
007836: }

007776:     if (!result && left_type && right_type && left_type->kind == right_type->kind)
007777:     {
007778:         result = left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT && left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
007779:         result = result || (left_type->bit_width == right_type->bit_width && left_type->is_signed == right_type->is_signed &&
007780:                             (left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT || left_type->float_format == right_type->float_format));
007781:     }
007782: 
007783:     return result;
007784: }
007785: 
007786: // Whether a value may cross into an object of `target` without a cast, for the
007787: // one class C makes an error of that this frontend used to accept in silence:
007788: // two pointers to functions whose prototypes disagree (#830). Clang has made it
007789: // an error by default since Clang 16 and GCC diagnoses it too, and the silence
007790: // flipped autoconf probes that read the diagnostic as their answer -- CPython's
007791: // readline check assigns `int(const char*, int)` to an `int(*)(void)` and
007792: // concludes from the refusal that the hook takes no arguments.
007793: //
007794: // Only a mismatch both reference compilers reject is reported, and only when
007795: // both sides are function pointers: a `void*` on either side is the idiom every
007796: // dispatch table is built from, and an unprototyped `()` is compatible with a
007797: // non-variadic prototype by C11 6.2.7p3 -- musl's `long __syscall_cp_asm();`
007798: // beside its eight-parameter prototype is one function, not two. Within that,
007799: // the parameter count, the variadic-ness, and the kind (and scalar width) of
007800: // the return and of each parameter have to agree. Anything subtler is accepted:
007801: // a false refusal would reject a translation unit clang compiles, which is a
007802: // worse failure than the silence this replaces.
007803: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left, IrTypeId right)
007804: {
007805:     IrType* left_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left);
007806:     IrType* right_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right);
007807:     bool result = true;
007808:     if (left.value != right.value && left_type && right_type && left_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION && right_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION &&
007809:         !left_type->is_unprototyped && !right_type->is_unprototyped)
007810:     {
007811:         result = left_type->parameter_count == right_type->parameter_count && left_type->is_variadic == right_type->is_variadic &&
007812:                  c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(builder, left_type->return_type, right_type->return_type);
007813:         for (u32 index = 0; result && index < left_type->parameter_count; index += 1)
007814:         {
007815:             result = c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(builder, left_type->parameter_types[index], right_type->parameter_types[index]);
007816:         }
007817:     }
007818: 
007819:     return result;
007820: }
007821: 
007822: // The pointer wrapper around c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible: an
007823: // assignment crosses two *pointers*, and only when both point at functions is
007824: // there a prototype to compare.
007825: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_pointer_assignment_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId target, IrTypeId source)
007826: {
007827:     IrType* target_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target);
007828:     IrType* source_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, source);
007829:     bool result = true;
007830:     if (target_type && source_type && target_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && source_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
007831:     {
007832:         result = c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible(builder, target_type->element_type, source_type->element_type);
007833:     }
007834: 
007835:     return result;
007836: }

007973: // Whether a promoted-member search has already queued `type`.
007974: //
007975: // The two searches below (this one and c_ir_promoted_member_path) walk the
007976: // anonymous nested aggregates of one struct or union, so their work lists hold
007977: // a handful of entries and almost always exactly one. Both used to answer this
007978: // question with a `bool` array indexed by type id, allocated and memset per
007979: // call over the whole program type table: 72.167 calls at a mean capacity of
007980: // 17.432 types, 1,26 GB of zeroing per self-host compile, 6,74% of every
007981: // stage-1 L1d miss for a set that never held more than a few members (audit
007982: // 2026-08-22T084855Z). The work list is the visited set; scanning it costs
007983: // less than clearing the table did.
007984: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_type_queued(const IrTypeId* queued, u32 count, IrTypeId type)
007985: {
007986:     bool found = false;
007987:     for (u32 index = 0; index < count; index += 1)
007988:     {
007989:         if (queued[index].value == type.value)
007990:         {
007991:             found = true;
007992:             break;
007993:         }
007994:     }
007995:     return found;
007996: }

008633: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_parameter(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken name, u32 argument_index, IrTypeId type, IrTypeId object_type, CEntityId entity)
008634: {
008635:     // A by-value parameter is a local object, not the caller's ABI slot.
008636:     // Carry its type alignment just as an ordinary declaration does: native
008637:     // lowering uses the place's alignment to reserve and materialize storage
008638:     // beyond the frame pointer's guaranteed alignment.
008639:     IrType* parameter_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
008640:     u32 alignment = parameter_type ? parameter_type->layout.alignment : 0;
008641:     IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_local(builder, name, object_type, entity, alignment);
008642:     CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
008643:     if (place.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !local)
008644:     {
008645:         return false;
008646:     }
008647:     local->is_parameter = true;
008648:     // The pointer an array parameter was adjusted to points at the element
008649:     // type, qualifiers included: `const struct timespec times[2]` yields a
008650:     // modifiable pointer to constant elements, so the read-only answer moves
008651:     // from the object to what it points to.
008652:     if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
008653:     {
008654:         CTypeId declared = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type;
008655:         if (declared.value < builder->parse.type_count && builder->parse.types[declared.value].kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY &&
008656:             c_ir_c_type_is_read_only(builder, builder->parse.types[declared.value].element_type))
008657:         {
008658:             builder->function->values[place.value].points_to_read_only = true;
008659:         }
008660:     }
008661:     IrValueId value = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
008662:     u64* immediate = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
008663:     immediate[0] = argument_index;
008664:     IrSourceRange argument_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, name);
008665:     IrInstruction argument = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ARGUMENT, type);
008666:     argument.immediates = immediate;
008667:     argument.immediate_count = 1;
008668:     argument.result = value;
008669:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, argument, argument_source);
008670:     builder->function->values[value.value].definition = id;
008671:     bool stored = c_ir_emit_store(builder, local, value, argument_source);
008672:     if (stored)
008673:     {
008674:         c_ir_mark_local_read_only(builder, local);
008675:     }
008676:     return stored;
008677: }

008683:                                                        IrTypeId type)
008684: {

008633: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_parameter(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken name, u32 argument_index, IrTypeId type, IrTypeId object_type, CEntityId entity)
008634: {
008635:     // A by-value parameter is a local object, not the caller's ABI slot.
008636:     // Carry its type alignment just as an ordinary declaration does: native
008637:     // lowering uses the place's alignment to reserve and materialize storage
008638:     // beyond the frame pointer's guaranteed alignment.
008639:     IrType* parameter_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
