018212: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_vector_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
018213: {
018214:     IrTypeId element = builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR];
018215:     IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element);
018216:     if (!element_type || element_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || element_type->bit_width != 8)
018217:     {
018218:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018219:     }
018220:     for (u32 type_index = 0; type_index < builder->program->types.count; type_index += 1)
018221:     {
018222:         IrType* candidate = builder->program->types.types + type_index;
018223:         if (candidate->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && candidate->element_type.value == element.value && candidate->element_count == 64 &&
018224:             candidate->layout.size == 64)
018225:         {
018226:             return candidate->id;
018227:         }
018228:     }
018229:     return ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
018230:                                                      .name = S8("GNU vector"),
018231:                                                      .element_type = element,
018232:                                                      .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
018233:                                                      .layout =
018234:                                                          {
018235:                                                              .size = 64,
018236:                                                              .alignment = 64,
018237:                                                              .resolved = true,
018238:                                                          },
018239:                                                      .kind = IR_TYPE_VECTOR,
018240:                                                      .element_count = 64,
018241:                                                      .bit_width = 512,
018242:                                                  });
018243: }
018244: 
018245: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_result_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSimdOperation operation)
018246: {
018247:     IrSimdShape shape = ir_simd_operation_shape(operation);
018248:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018249:     if (shape.semantic_class == IR_VECTOR_SEMANTICS_EXACT_X86_512)
018250:     {
018251:         result = !shape.has_result ? builder->void_type : shape.predicate_result ? builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG] :
018252:                  c_ir_simd_vector_type(builder);
018253:     }
018254:     return result;
018255: }
018256: 
018257: // Arguments get exactly the conversions C would already have applied at a call
018258: // with this prototype: arrays decay, integers convert. A vector argument is
018259: // checked and never converted — a silent lane reinterpretation is the one
018260: // thing an explicit SIMD kernel must not get.
018261: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_simd_coerce_argument(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, CIrSimdArgument kind, IrSourceRange source)
018262: {
018263:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
018264:     {
018265:         IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
018266:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
018267:         if (type)
018268:         {
018269:             switch (kind)
018270:             {
018271:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_ADDRESS:
018272:             {
018273:                 if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR)
018274:                 {
018275:                     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
018276:                     value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
018277:                     type = value.value < builder->function->value_count ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type) : 0;
018278:                 }
018279:                 return type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018280:             }
018281:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_MASK:
018282:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018283:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG], source)
018284:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018285:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_BYTE:
018286:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018287:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR], source)
018288:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018289:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_WORD:
018290:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018291:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT], source)
018292:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018293:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_VECTOR:
018294:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == 64 ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018295:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_IMMEDIATE:
018296:                 break;
018297:             }
018298:         }
018299:     }
018300: 
018301:     return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018302: }
018303: 
018304: // A call whose parentheses hold a lazily evaluated operand had the calls in
018305: // that operand left unprepared (c_ir_prepare_calls_discover), so the child
018306: // expression about to be lowered has to prepare them itself, inside whichever
018307: // block ends up running. That only happens with preparation off; the enclosing
018308: // pass resumes owning it when the child finishes.
018309: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
018310: {
018311:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls = builder->preparing_calls;
===== line 18195 =====
018115:         u32 call_index;
018116:         bool finish;
018117:         u8 reserved[3];
018118:     };
018119:     CIrCallEmissionTask* tasks = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrCallEmissionTask, remaining ? (u64)remaining * 2 : 1);
018120:     u32* emission_order = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, u32, remaining ? remaining : 1);
018121:     u32 task_count = 0;
018122:     u32 emission_count = 0;
018123:     for (u32 root = last_root; root != UINT32_MAX; root = builder->prepared_calls[root].previous_sibling_index)
018124:     {
018125:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018126:             .call_index = root,
018127:         };
018128:     }
018129:     while (task_count)
018130:     {
018131:         CIrCallEmissionTask task = tasks[--task_count];
018132:         CIrPreparedCall* call = builder->prepared_calls + task.call_index;
018133:         if (task.finish)
018134:         {
018135:             emission_order[emission_count++] = task.call_index;
018136:             continue;
018137:         }
018138:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018139:             .call_index = task.call_index,
018140:             .finish = true,
018141:         };
018142:         for (u32 child = call->last_child_index; child != UINT32_MAX; child = builder->prepared_calls[child].previous_sibling_index)
018143:         {
018144:             tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018145:                 .call_index = child,
018146:             };
018147:         }
018148:     }
018149:     BUSTER_CHECK(emission_count == remaining);
018150:     *emission_order_out = emission_order;
018151:     *emission_count_out = emission_count;
018152:     return true;
018153: }
018154: 
018155: // The one vector type the 512-bit vocabulary speaks in: 64 bytes of u8. Every
018156: // builtin that returns a vector returns this, and `Simd512` in
018157: // <buster/lib/simd.h> is declared to match, so no conversion ever appears at a
018158: // call site. The layout matches what the `vector_size` attribute produces for
018159: // the same spelling, so the two are the same IR type and not two that happen to
018160: // agree.
018161: // __builtin_popcount is one instruction where the target has POPCNT and the
018162: // classic SWAR sequence where it does not, decided here rather than in the
018163: // backends: an IR expansion is the same handful of ordinary instructions every
018164: // backend already emits, and it keeps AArch64 from needing a NEON round trip
018165: // for a scalar operation the compiler itself barely uses.
018166: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_population_count(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId operand, IrTypeId type, CToken token, IrSourceRange source)
018167: {
018168:     IrType* integer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
018169:     if (!integer || integer->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
018170:     {
018171:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018172:     }
018173:     if (target_cpu_feature_has(builder->target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_POPCNT))
018174:     {
018175:         IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
018176:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNARY, type);
018177:         instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
018178:         instruction.operands[0] = operand;
018179:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
018180:         instruction.unary_operation = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_POPULATION_COUNT;
018181:         instruction.result = result;
018182:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
018183:         return result;
018184:     }
018185:     // The classic SWAR sequence: subtract the odd bits to make two-bit sums,
018186:     // add the pairs into four-bit sums, fold to bytes, then let one multiply
018187:     // gather every byte sum into the top byte.
018188:     u32 width = integer->bit_width;
018189:     u64 mask = width >= 64 ? UINT64_MAX : (((u64)1 << width) - 1);
018190:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, type);
018191:     IrValueId odd_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x5555555555555555) & mask, false, token, type);
018192:     IrValueId shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, one, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018193:     IrValueId high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, odd_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018194:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
018195:     IrValueId two = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 2, false, token, type);
018196:     IrValueId pair_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x3333333333333333) & mask, false, token, type);
018197:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, two, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018198:     high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018199:     IrValueId low = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018200:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, low, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018201:     IrValueId four = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, token, type);
018202:     IrValueId nibble_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) & mask, false, token, type);
018203:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, four, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018204:     IrValueId summed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shifted, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018205:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, summed, nibble_mask, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018206:     IrValueId ones = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101) & mask, false, token, type);
018207:     IrValueId gathered = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, ones, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
018208:     IrValueId top = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width - 8, false, token, type);
018209:     return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, gathered, top, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018210: }

018191:     IrValueId odd_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x5555555555555555) & mask, false, token, type);
018192:     IrValueId shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, one, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018193:     IrValueId high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, odd_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018194:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
018195:     IrValueId two = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 2, false, token, type);
018196:     IrValueId pair_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x3333333333333333) & mask, false, token, type);
018197:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, two, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018198:     high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018199:     IrValueId low = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018200:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, low, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018201:     IrValueId four = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, token, type);
018202:     IrValueId nibble_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) & mask, false, token, type);
018203:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, four, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018204:     IrValueId summed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shifted, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018205:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, summed, nibble_mask, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018206:     IrValueId ones = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101) & mask, false, token, type);
018207:     IrValueId gathered = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, ones, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
018208:     IrValueId top = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width - 8, false, token, type);
018209:     return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, gathered, top, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018210: }

018212: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_vector_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
018213: {
018214:     IrTypeId element = builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR];
018215:     IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element);
018216:     if (!element_type || element_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || element_type->bit_width != 8)
018217:     {
018218:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018219:     }
018220:     for (u32 type_index = 0; type_index < builder->program->types.count; type_index += 1)
018221:     {
018222:         IrType* candidate = builder->program->types.types + type_index;
018223:         if (candidate->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && candidate->element_type.value == element.value && candidate->element_count == 64 &&
018224:             candidate->layout.size == 64)
018225:         {
018226:             return candidate->id;
018227:         }
018228:     }
018229:     return ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
018230:                                                      .name = S8("GNU vector"),
018231:                                                      .element_type = element,
018232:                                                      .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
018233:                                                      .layout =
018234:                                                          {
018235:                                                              .size = 64,
018236:                                                              .alignment = 64,
018237:                                                              .resolved = true,
018238:                                                          },
018239:                                                      .kind = IR_TYPE_VECTOR,
018240:                                                      .element_count = 64,
018241:                                                      .bit_width = 512,
018242:                                                  });
018243: }

018245: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_result_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSimdOperation operation)
018246: {
018247:     IrSimdShape shape = ir_simd_operation_shape(operation);
018248:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018249:     if (shape.semantic_class == IR_VECTOR_SEMANTICS_EXACT_X86_512)
018250:     {
018251:         result = !shape.has_result ? builder->void_type : shape.predicate_result ? builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG] :
018252:                  c_ir_simd_vector_type(builder);
018253:     }
018254:     return result;
018255: }
018256: 
018257: // Arguments get exactly the conversions C would already have applied at a call
018258: // with this prototype: arrays decay, integers convert. A vector argument is
018259: // checked and never converted — a silent lane reinterpretation is the one
018260: // thing an explicit SIMD kernel must not get.
018261: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_simd_coerce_argument(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, CIrSimdArgument kind, IrSourceRange source)
018262: {
018263:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
018264:     {
018265:         IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
018266:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
018267:         if (type)
018268:         {
018269:             switch (kind)
018270:             {
018271:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_ADDRESS:
018272:             {
018273:                 if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR)
018274:                 {
018275:                     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
018276:                     value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
018277:                     type = value.value < builder->function->value_count ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type) : 0;
018278:                 }
018279:                 return type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018280:             }
018281:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_MASK:
018282:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018283:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG], source)
018284:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018285:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_BYTE:
018286:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018287:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR], source)
018288:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018289:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_WORD:
018290:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018291:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT], source)
018292:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018293:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_VECTOR:
018294:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == 64 ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018295:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_IMMEDIATE:
018296:                 break;
018297:             }
018298:         }
018299:     }
018300: 
018301:     return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018302: }
018303: 
018304: // A call whose parentheses hold a lazily evaluated operand had the calls in
018305: // that operand left unprepared (c_ir_prepare_calls_discover), so the child
018306: // expression about to be lowered has to prepare them itself, inside whichever
018307: // block ends up running. That only happens with preparation off; the enclosing
018308: // pass resumes owning it when the child finishes.
018309: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
018310: {
018311:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls = builder->preparing_calls;
018312:     if (builder->prepared_calls[frame->as.prepared_call.call_index].deferred_calls)
018313:     {
018314:         builder->preparing_calls = false;
018315:     }
018316: }
===== line 18201 =====
018121:     u32 task_count = 0;
018122:     u32 emission_count = 0;
018123:     for (u32 root = last_root; root != UINT32_MAX; root = builder->prepared_calls[root].previous_sibling_index)
018124:     {
018125:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018126:             .call_index = root,
018127:         };
018128:     }
018129:     while (task_count)
018130:     {
018131:         CIrCallEmissionTask task = tasks[--task_count];
018132:         CIrPreparedCall* call = builder->prepared_calls + task.call_index;
018133:         if (task.finish)
018134:         {
018135:             emission_order[emission_count++] = task.call_index;
018136:             continue;
018137:         }
018138:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018139:             .call_index = task.call_index,
018140:             .finish = true,
018141:         };
018142:         for (u32 child = call->last_child_index; child != UINT32_MAX; child = builder->prepared_calls[child].previous_sibling_index)
018143:         {
018144:             tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018145:                 .call_index = child,
018146:             };
018147:         }
018148:     }
018149:     BUSTER_CHECK(emission_count == remaining);
018150:     *emission_order_out = emission_order;
018151:     *emission_count_out = emission_count;
018152:     return true;
018153: }
018154: 
018155: // The one vector type the 512-bit vocabulary speaks in: 64 bytes of u8. Every
018156: // builtin that returns a vector returns this, and `Simd512` in
018157: // <buster/lib/simd.h> is declared to match, so no conversion ever appears at a
018158: // call site. The layout matches what the `vector_size` attribute produces for
018159: // the same spelling, so the two are the same IR type and not two that happen to
018160: // agree.
018161: // __builtin_popcount is one instruction where the target has POPCNT and the
018162: // classic SWAR sequence where it does not, decided here rather than in the
018163: // backends: an IR expansion is the same handful of ordinary instructions every
018164: // backend already emits, and it keeps AArch64 from needing a NEON round trip
018165: // for a scalar operation the compiler itself barely uses.
018166: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_population_count(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId operand, IrTypeId type, CToken token, IrSourceRange source)
018167: {
018168:     IrType* integer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
018169:     if (!integer || integer->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
018170:     {
018171:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018172:     }
018173:     if (target_cpu_feature_has(builder->target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_POPCNT))
018174:     {
018175:         IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
018176:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNARY, type);
018177:         instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
018178:         instruction.operands[0] = operand;
018179:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
018180:         instruction.unary_operation = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_POPULATION_COUNT;
018181:         instruction.result = result;
018182:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
018183:         return result;
018184:     }
018185:     // The classic SWAR sequence: subtract the odd bits to make two-bit sums,
018186:     // add the pairs into four-bit sums, fold to bytes, then let one multiply
018187:     // gather every byte sum into the top byte.
018188:     u32 width = integer->bit_width;
018189:     u64 mask = width >= 64 ? UINT64_MAX : (((u64)1 << width) - 1);
018190:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, type);
018191:     IrValueId odd_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x5555555555555555) & mask, false, token, type);
018192:     IrValueId shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, one, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018193:     IrValueId high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, odd_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018194:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
018195:     IrValueId two = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 2, false, token, type);
018196:     IrValueId pair_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x3333333333333333) & mask, false, token, type);
018197:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, two, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018198:     high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018199:     IrValueId low = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018200:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, low, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018201:     IrValueId four = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, token, type);
018202:     IrValueId nibble_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) & mask, false, token, type);
018203:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, four, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018204:     IrValueId summed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shifted, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018205:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, summed, nibble_mask, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018206:     IrValueId ones = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101) & mask, false, token, type);
018207:     IrValueId gathered = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, ones, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
018208:     IrValueId top = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width - 8, false, token, type);
018209:     return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, gathered, top, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018210: }

018186:     // add the pairs into four-bit sums, fold to bytes, then let one multiply
018187:     // gather every byte sum into the top byte.
018188:     u32 width = integer->bit_width;
018189:     u64 mask = width >= 64 ? UINT64_MAX : (((u64)1 << width) - 1);
018190:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, type);
018191:     IrValueId odd_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x5555555555555555) & mask, false, token, type);
018192:     IrValueId shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, one, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018193:     IrValueId high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, odd_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018194:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
018195:     IrValueId two = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 2, false, token, type);
018196:     IrValueId pair_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x3333333333333333) & mask, false, token, type);
018197:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, two, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018198:     high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018199:     IrValueId low = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018200:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, low, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018201:     IrValueId four = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, token, type);
018202:     IrValueId nibble_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) & mask, false, token, type);
018203:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, four, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018204:     IrValueId summed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shifted, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018205:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, summed, nibble_mask, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018206:     IrValueId ones = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101) & mask, false, token, type);
018207:     IrValueId gathered = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, ones, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
018208:     IrValueId top = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width - 8, false, token, type);
018209:     return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, gathered, top, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018210: }

018212: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_vector_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
018213: {
018214:     IrTypeId element = builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR];
018215:     IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element);
018216:     if (!element_type || element_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || element_type->bit_width != 8)
018217:     {
018218:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018219:     }
018220:     for (u32 type_index = 0; type_index < builder->program->types.count; type_index += 1)
018221:     {
018222:         IrType* candidate = builder->program->types.types + type_index;
018223:         if (candidate->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && candidate->element_type.value == element.value && candidate->element_count == 64 &&
018224:             candidate->layout.size == 64)
018225:         {
018226:             return candidate->id;
018227:         }
018228:     }
018229:     return ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
018230:                                                      .name = S8("GNU vector"),
018231:                                                      .element_type = element,
018232:                                                      .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
018233:                                                      .layout =
018234:                                                          {
018235:                                                              .size = 64,
018236:                                                              .alignment = 64,
018237:                                                              .resolved = true,
018238:                                                          },
018239:                                                      .kind = IR_TYPE_VECTOR,
018240:                                                      .element_count = 64,
018241:                                                      .bit_width = 512,
018242:                                                  });
018243: }
018244: 
018245: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_result_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSimdOperation operation)
018246: {
018247:     IrSimdShape shape = ir_simd_operation_shape(operation);
018248:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018249:     if (shape.semantic_class == IR_VECTOR_SEMANTICS_EXACT_X86_512)
018250:     {
018251:         result = !shape.has_result ? builder->void_type : shape.predicate_result ? builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG] :
018252:                  c_ir_simd_vector_type(builder);
018253:     }
018254:     return result;
018255: }
018256: 
018257: // Arguments get exactly the conversions C would already have applied at a call
018258: // with this prototype: arrays decay, integers convert. A vector argument is
018259: // checked and never converted — a silent lane reinterpretation is the one
018260: // thing an explicit SIMD kernel must not get.
018261: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_simd_coerce_argument(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, CIrSimdArgument kind, IrSourceRange source)
018262: {
018263:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
018264:     {
018265:         IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
018266:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
018267:         if (type)
018268:         {
018269:             switch (kind)
018270:             {
018271:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_ADDRESS:
018272:             {
018273:                 if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR)
018274:                 {
018275:                     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
018276:                     value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
018277:                     type = value.value < builder->function->value_count ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type) : 0;
018278:                 }
018279:                 return type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018280:             }
018281:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_MASK:
018282:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018283:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG], source)
018284:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018285:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_BYTE:
018286:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018287:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR], source)
018288:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018289:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_WORD:
018290:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018291:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT], source)
018292:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018293:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_VECTOR:
018294:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == 64 ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018295:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_IMMEDIATE:
018296:                 break;
018297:             }
018298:         }
018299:     }
018300: 
018301:     return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018302: }
018303: 
018304: // A call whose parentheses hold a lazily evaluated operand had the calls in
018305: // that operand left unprepared (c_ir_prepare_calls_discover), so the child
018306: // expression about to be lowered has to prepare them itself, inside whichever
018307: // block ends up running. That only happens with preparation off; the enclosing
018308: // pass resumes owning it when the child finishes.
018309: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
018310: {
018311:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls = builder->preparing_calls;
018312:     if (builder->prepared_calls[frame->as.prepared_call.call_index].deferred_calls)
018313:     {
018314:         builder->preparing_calls = false;
018315:     }
018316: }
018317: 
018318: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
018319:                                                                                     CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation, u32 start, u32 end,
018320:                                                                                     bool va_list_operand)
018321: {
018322:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->continuation = (u32)continuation;
===== line 18206 =====
018126:             .call_index = root,
018127:         };
018128:     }
018129:     while (task_count)
018130:     {
018131:         CIrCallEmissionTask task = tasks[--task_count];
018132:         CIrPreparedCall* call = builder->prepared_calls + task.call_index;
018133:         if (task.finish)
018134:         {
018135:             emission_order[emission_count++] = task.call_index;
018136:             continue;
018137:         }
018138:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018139:             .call_index = task.call_index,
018140:             .finish = true,
018141:         };
018142:         for (u32 child = call->last_child_index; child != UINT32_MAX; child = builder->prepared_calls[child].previous_sibling_index)
018143:         {
018144:             tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
018145:                 .call_index = child,
018146:             };
018147:         }
018148:     }
018149:     BUSTER_CHECK(emission_count == remaining);
018150:     *emission_order_out = emission_order;
018151:     *emission_count_out = emission_count;
018152:     return true;
018153: }
018154: 
018155: // The one vector type the 512-bit vocabulary speaks in: 64 bytes of u8. Every
018156: // builtin that returns a vector returns this, and `Simd512` in
018157: // <buster/lib/simd.h> is declared to match, so no conversion ever appears at a
018158: // call site. The layout matches what the `vector_size` attribute produces for
018159: // the same spelling, so the two are the same IR type and not two that happen to
018160: // agree.
018161: // __builtin_popcount is one instruction where the target has POPCNT and the
018162: // classic SWAR sequence where it does not, decided here rather than in the
018163: // backends: an IR expansion is the same handful of ordinary instructions every
018164: // backend already emits, and it keeps AArch64 from needing a NEON round trip
018165: // for a scalar operation the compiler itself barely uses.
018166: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_population_count(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId operand, IrTypeId type, CToken token, IrSourceRange source)
018167: {
018168:     IrType* integer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
018169:     if (!integer || integer->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
018170:     {
018171:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018172:     }
018173:     if (target_cpu_feature_has(builder->target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_POPCNT))
018174:     {
018175:         IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
018176:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNARY, type);
018177:         instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
018178:         instruction.operands[0] = operand;
018179:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
018180:         instruction.unary_operation = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_POPULATION_COUNT;
018181:         instruction.result = result;
018182:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
018183:         return result;
018184:     }
018185:     // The classic SWAR sequence: subtract the odd bits to make two-bit sums,
018186:     // add the pairs into four-bit sums, fold to bytes, then let one multiply
018187:     // gather every byte sum into the top byte.
018188:     u32 width = integer->bit_width;
018189:     u64 mask = width >= 64 ? UINT64_MAX : (((u64)1 << width) - 1);
018190:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, type);
018191:     IrValueId odd_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x5555555555555555) & mask, false, token, type);
018192:     IrValueId shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, one, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018193:     IrValueId high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, odd_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018194:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
018195:     IrValueId two = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 2, false, token, type);
018196:     IrValueId pair_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x3333333333333333) & mask, false, token, type);
018197:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, two, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018198:     high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018199:     IrValueId low = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018200:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, low, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018201:     IrValueId four = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, token, type);
018202:     IrValueId nibble_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) & mask, false, token, type);
018203:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, four, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018204:     IrValueId summed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shifted, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018205:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, summed, nibble_mask, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018206:     IrValueId ones = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101) & mask, false, token, type);
018207:     IrValueId gathered = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, ones, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
018208:     IrValueId top = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width - 8, false, token, type);
018209:     return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, gathered, top, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018210: }

018178:         instruction.operands[0] = operand;
018179:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
018180:         instruction.unary_operation = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_POPULATION_COUNT;
018181:         instruction.result = result;
018182:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
018183:         return result;
018184:     }
018185:     // The classic SWAR sequence: subtract the odd bits to make two-bit sums,
018186:     // add the pairs into four-bit sums, fold to bytes, then let one multiply
018187:     // gather every byte sum into the top byte.
018188:     u32 width = integer->bit_width;
018189:     u64 mask = width >= 64 ? UINT64_MAX : (((u64)1 << width) - 1);
018190:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, type);
018191:     IrValueId odd_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x5555555555555555) & mask, false, token, type);
018192:     IrValueId shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, one, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018193:     IrValueId high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, odd_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018194:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
018195:     IrValueId two = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 2, false, token, type);
018196:     IrValueId pair_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x3333333333333333) & mask, false, token, type);
018197:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, two, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018198:     high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018199:     IrValueId low = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018200:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, low, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018201:     IrValueId four = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, token, type);
018202:     IrValueId nibble_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) & mask, false, token, type);
018203:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, four, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018204:     IrValueId summed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shifted, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
018205:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, summed, nibble_mask, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
018206:     IrValueId ones = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101) & mask, false, token, type);
018207:     IrValueId gathered = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, ones, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
018208:     IrValueId top = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width - 8, false, token, type);
018209:     return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, gathered, top, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
018210: }

018212: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_vector_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
018213: {
018214:     IrTypeId element = builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR];
018215:     IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element);
018216:     if (!element_type || element_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || element_type->bit_width != 8)
018217:     {
018218:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018219:     }
018220:     for (u32 type_index = 0; type_index < builder->program->types.count; type_index += 1)
018221:     {
018222:         IrType* candidate = builder->program->types.types + type_index;
018223:         if (candidate->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && candidate->element_type.value == element.value && candidate->element_count == 64 &&
018224:             candidate->layout.size == 64)
018225:         {
018226:             return candidate->id;
018227:         }
018228:     }
018229:     return ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
018230:                                                      .name = S8("GNU vector"),
018231:                                                      .element_type = element,
018232:                                                      .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
018233:                                                      .layout =
018234:                                                          {
018235:                                                              .size = 64,
018236:                                                              .alignment = 64,
018237:                                                              .resolved = true,
018238:                                                          },
018239:                                                      .kind = IR_TYPE_VECTOR,
018240:                                                      .element_count = 64,
018241:                                                      .bit_width = 512,
018242:                                                  });
018243: }

018245: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_result_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSimdOperation operation)
018246: {
018247:     IrSimdShape shape = ir_simd_operation_shape(operation);
018248:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018249:     if (shape.semantic_class == IR_VECTOR_SEMANTICS_EXACT_X86_512)
018250:     {
018251:         result = !shape.has_result ? builder->void_type : shape.predicate_result ? builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG] :
018252:                  c_ir_simd_vector_type(builder);
018253:     }
018254:     return result;
018255: }

018257: // Arguments get exactly the conversions C would already have applied at a call
018258: // with this prototype: arrays decay, integers convert. A vector argument is
018259: // checked and never converted — a silent lane reinterpretation is the one
018260: // thing an explicit SIMD kernel must not get.
018261: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_simd_coerce_argument(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, CIrSimdArgument kind, IrSourceRange source)
018262: {
018263:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
018264:     {
018265:         IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
018266:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
018267:         if (type)
018268:         {
018269:             switch (kind)
018270:             {
018271:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_ADDRESS:
018272:             {
018273:                 if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR)
018274:                 {
018275:                     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
018276:                     value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
018277:                     type = value.value < builder->function->value_count ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type) : 0;
018278:                 }
018279:                 return type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018280:             }
018281:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_MASK:
018282:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018283:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG], source)
018284:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018285:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_BYTE:
018286:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018287:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR], source)
018288:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018289:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_WORD:
018290:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
018291:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT], source)
018292:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018293:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_VECTOR:
018294:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == 64 ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018295:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_IMMEDIATE:
018296:                 break;
018297:             }
018298:         }
018299:     }
018300: 
018301:     return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018302: }
018303: 
018304: // A call whose parentheses hold a lazily evaluated operand had the calls in
018305: // that operand left unprepared (c_ir_prepare_calls_discover), so the child
018306: // expression about to be lowered has to prepare them itself, inside whichever
018307: // block ends up running. That only happens with preparation off; the enclosing
018308: // pass resumes owning it when the child finishes.
018309: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
018310: {
018311:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls = builder->preparing_calls;
018312:     if (builder->prepared_calls[frame->as.prepared_call.call_index].deferred_calls)
018313:     {
018314:         builder->preparing_calls = false;
018315:     }
018316: }
018317: 
018318: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
018319:                                                                                     CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation, u32 start, u32 end,
018320:                                                                                     bool va_list_operand)
018321: {
018322:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->continuation = (u32)continuation;
018323:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
018324:     c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(builder, frame);
018325:     if (va_list_operand)
018326:     {
018327:         frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_va_list_operand = builder->va_list_builtin_operand;
018328:         builder->va_list_builtin_operand = true;
===== line 18408 =====
018328:         builder->va_list_builtin_operand = true;
018329:     }
018330:     if (!c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
018331:                                             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION,
018332:                                             .as.expression =
018333:                                                 {
018334:                                                     .start = start,
018335:                                                     .end = end,
018336:                                                 },
018337:                                         }))
018338:     {
018339:         if (va_list_operand)
018340:         {
018341:             builder->va_list_builtin_operand = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_va_list_operand;
018342:         }
018343:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls;
018344:         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
018345:     }
018346:     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_SUSPENDED;
018347: }

018349: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_prepared_call_request_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
018350:                                                                                CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation, u32 start, u32 end)
018351: {
018352:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->continuation = (u32)continuation;
018353:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
018354:     c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(builder, frame);
018355:     if (!c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
018356:                                             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PLACE,
018357:                                             .as.place =
018358:                                                 {
018359:                                                     .start = start,
018360:                                                     .end = end,
018361:                                                 },
018362:                                         }))
018363:     {
018364:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls;
018365:         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
018366:     }
018367:     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_SUSPENDED;
018368: }
018369: 
018370: // Aggregate exchanges compare the promoted object's representation. Keep the
018371: // atomic instruction integer-typed: two pointer views name the same object,
018372: // and private scalar storage carries values between the record and its bits.
018373: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId object_type,
018374:                                                             IrTypeId bits_type, IrSourceRange source)
018375: {
018376:     IrType* object = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
018377:     IrType* bits = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, bits_type);
018378:     // GNU's generic forms name an ordinary object, while C11 aggregate
018379:     // exchange/CAS name an atomic-qualified one. In both cases the integer
018380:     // view must cover exactly the storage the caller supplied.
018381:     bool valid = object && bits && object->layout.resolved && bits->layout.resolved &&
018382:                  object->layout.size == bits->layout.size && bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
018383:     IrTypeId atomic_bits = valid ? c_ir_add_qualified_type(builder->program, bits_type, true, object->is_volatile) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018384:     IrTypeId pointer_type = valid ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, atomic_bits) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018385:     IrValueId address = valid ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, object_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018386:     IrValueId cast = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018387:     IrValueId result = cast.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, cast, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018388:     return result;
018389: }
018390: 
018391: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId record_type,
018392:                                                             IrTypeId bits_type, bool to_bits, IrSourceRange source)
018393: {
018394:     IrType* record = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, record_type);
018395:     IrType* bits = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, bits_type);
018396:     bool valid = record && bits && record->layout.resolved && bits->layout.resolved && record->layout.size <= bits->layout.size &&
018397:                  value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
018398:     IrValueId slot = valid ? c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, bits_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018399:     IrTypeId pointer_type = valid ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, record_type) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018400:     IrValueId address = valid ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, slot, bits_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018401:     IrValueId cast = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018402:     IrValueId record_place = cast.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, cast, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018403:     valid = valid && record_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
018404:     if (valid && to_bits)
018405:     {
018406:         // A three-byte record uses a four-byte atomic object. Initialize the
018407:         // promoted tail before writing the record, matching aggregate stores.
018408:         IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, bits_type);
018409:         valid = zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, bits_type, zero, source) &&
018410:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, record_place, record_type, value, source);
018411:     }
018412:     else if (valid)
018413:     {
018414:         valid = c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, bits_type, value, source);
018415:     }
018416:     IrValueId result = valid ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, to_bits ? slot : record_place, to_bits ? bits_type : record_type, source)
018417:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
018418:     return result;
018419: }

018421: // Builtins consume a pointer to the existing target-specific list object.
018422: // Check this at the frontend boundary instead of publishing malformed VA IR.
018423: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_va_list_operand_valid(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value)
018424: {
018425:     IrType* pointer = value.value < builder->function->value_count
018426:                           ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type) : 0;
018427:     IrType* list = pointer && pointer->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pointer->element_type) : 0;
018428:     return list && list->kind == IR_TYPE_VA_LIST;
018429: }

018431: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_emit_va_list_call_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,

018433:                                                                         IrValueId child_value)
018434: {

018436:     CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[selected->token_index];

018523:         }
018524:     }
018525:     if (!valid)
018526:     {
018527:         if (!builder->failure_message.length)
018528:         {
018529:             builder->failure_message = selected->builtin_va_end ? S8("va_end requires a va_list operand") :
018530:                 S8("va_start/va_copy requires a modifiable va_list destination and valid arguments");
018531:             builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
018532:         }
018533:         step = C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
018534:     }
018535:     return step;
018536: }

018538: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_emit_prepared_call_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
018539: {
018540:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
018541:     u32 call_index = frame->as.prepared_call.call_index;
018542:     bool child_success = frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD && machine->child_result.success;
018543:     IrValueId child_value = machine->child_result.value;
018544:     CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation = (CIrPreparedCallContinuation)frame->as.prepared_call.state->continuation;
018545:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD &&
018546:         (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_END || continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_COPY ||
018547:          continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_ARG))
018548:     {
018549:         builder->va_list_builtin_operand = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_va_list_operand;
018550:     }
018551:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD)
018552:     {
018553:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls;
018554:     }
018555:     u32 remaining = 1;
018556:     do
018557:     {
018558:         CIrPreparedCall* selected = builder->prepared_calls + call_index;
018559:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[selected->token_index];
018560:         if (selected->builtin_constant_p || selected->builtin_choose_expr || selected->builtin_types_compatible_p || selected->builtin_object_size ||
018561:             selected->builtin_assume_aligned)
018562:         {
018563:             u32 starts[4] = {0};
018564:             u32 ends[4] = {0};
018565:             u32 argument_count = 0;
018566:             if (!c_ir_call_arguments(builder, selected, starts, ends, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(starts), &argument_count))
018567:             {
018568:                 return false;
018569:             }
018570:             if (selected->builtin_constant_p)
018571:             {
018572:                 CIrConstantValue value = {0};
018573:                 bool constant = argument_count == 1 && c_ir_constant_evaluate(builder, starts[0], ends[0], &value) &&
018574:                                 c_ir_constant_normalize(builder, &value) && value.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INVALID && value.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN &&
018575:                                 value.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
018576:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, constant ? 1 : 0, false, token, builder->s32_type);
018577:             }
018578:             else if (selected->builtin_choose_expr)
018579:             {
018580:                 u64 condition = 0;
018581:                 if (argument_count != 3 || !c_ir_constant_condition_evaluate(builder, starts[0], ends[0], &condition))
018582:                 {
018583:                     return false;
018584:                 }
018585:                 u32 branch = condition ? 1 : 2;
018586:                 if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_CHOOSE)
018587:                 {
018588:                     if (!child_success)
018589:                     {
018590:                         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
018591:                     }
018592:                     selected->result = child_value;
018593:                 }
018594:                 else
018595:                 {
018596:                     return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_CHOOSE, starts[branch], ends[branch], false);
018597:                 }
018598:             }
018599:             else if (selected->builtin_types_compatible_p)
018600:             {
018601:                 IrTypeId left = argument_count == 2 ? c_ir_type_name(builder, starts[0], ends[0]) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018602:                 IrTypeId right = argument_count == 2 ? c_ir_type_name(builder, starts[1], ends[1]) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
018603:                 if (left.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || right.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
018604:                 {
018605:                     return false;
018606:                 }
018607:                 bool compatible = c_ir_types_compatible(builder, left, right);
018608:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, compatible ? 1 : 0, false, token, builder->s32_type);
018609:             }
018610:             else if (selected->builtin_object_size)
018611:             {
018612:                 if (argument_count != 2)
018613:                 {
018614:                     return false;
018615:                 }
018616:                 u64 mode = 0;
018617:                 if (!c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[1], ends[1], &mode) || mode > 3)
018618:                 {
018619:                     return false;
018620:                 }
018621:                 u64 size = mode >= 2 ? 0 : UINT64_MAX;
018622:                 u32 object_start = starts[0];
018623:                 u32 object_end = ends[0];
018624:                 while (object_start < object_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[object_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
018625:                        c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, object_start, object_end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ==
018626:                            object_end - 1)
018627:                 {
018628:                     object_start += 1;
018629:                     object_end -= 1;
018630:                 }
018631:                 if (object_start < object_end && builder->preprocess.tokens[object_start].kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL &&
018632:                     c_ir_tokens_are_string_literals(builder->preprocess, object_start, object_end))
018633:                 {
018634:                     CIrDecodedString decoded = {0};
018635:                     if (!c_ir_decode_string_literal_range_for_target(builder->arena, builder->preprocess, builder->target, object_start, object_end, &decoded) ||
018636:                         decoded.element_count == UINT64_MAX || decoded.element_count + 1 > UINT64_MAX / decoded.element_width)
018637:                     {
018638:                         return false;
018639:                     }
018640:                     size = (decoded.element_count + 1) * decoded.element_width;
018641:                 }
018642:                 else if (object_start + 1 == object_end && builder->preprocess.tokens[object_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
018643:                 {
018644:                     CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, object_start);
018645:                     IrTypeId object_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;

018647:                     if (local)

018649:                         object_type = local->type;
018650:                     }
018651:                     else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
018652:                     {
018653:                         object_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type.value];
018654:                     }
018655:                     IrType* object = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
018656:                     if (object && object->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY && object->layout.resolved)
018657:                     {
018658:                         size = object->layout.size;
018659:                     }
018660:                 }
018661:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, size, false, token, builder->size_type);
018662:             }
018663:             else
018664:             {
018665:                 u64 alignment = 0;
018666:                 u64 offset = 0;
018667:                 if ((argument_count != 2 && argument_count != 3) ||
018668:                     !c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[1], ends[1], &alignment) || !alignment ||
018669:                     (argument_count == 3 && !c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[2], ends[2], &offset)))
018670:                 {
018671:                     return false;
018672:                 }
018673:                 if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ASSUME_ALIGNED)
018674:                 {
018675:                     if (!child_success)
018676:                     {
018677:                         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
018678:                     }
018679:                     selected->result = child_value;
018680:                 }
018681:                 else
018682:                 {
018683:                     return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ASSUME_ALIGNED, starts[0], ends[0], false);
018684:                 }
018685:                 if (selected->result.value >= builder->function->value_count)
018686:                 {
018687:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
018688:                 }
018689:                 IrType* aligned_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[selected->result.value].canonical_type);
018690:                 if (aligned_type && aligned_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
018691:                 {
018692:                     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, aligned_type->element_type);
018693:                     selected->result = c_ir_decay_array(builder, selected->result, pointer_type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
018694:                     aligned_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pointer_type);
018695:                 }
018696:                 if (!aligned_type || aligned_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)

018530:                 S8("va_start/va_copy requires a modifiable va_list destination and valid arguments");
018531:             builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
018532:         }
018533:         step = C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
018534:     }

019338:                 // C11's fetch-add on an atomic pointer is pointer arithmetic
019339:                 // and scales by the element size; the GNU family's is not.
019340:                 // `__atomic_add_fetch(&p, 2, ...)` on an `int*` advances p by
019341:                 // two *bytes* in clang and gcc alike, measured 2026-08-30, so
019342:                 // the GNU spelling deliberately skips the scaling below and
019343:                 // recomputes its answer as an integer.
019344:                 bool pointer_arithmetic = pointer_value &&
019345:                                           (selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_FETCH_ADD ||
019346:                                            selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_FETCH_SUBTRACT);
019347:                 // The scaling below turns an element count into a byte count
019348:                 // for the instruction; `__atomic_add_fetch` has to re-apply the
019349:                 // operation to the value the caller wrote, so the operand is
019350:                 // kept as it arrived.

021096: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_vector_splat(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId vector_type, IrSourceRange source)
021097: {
021098:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, vector_type);
021099:     if (!vector || vector->kind != IR_TYPE_VECTOR || !vector->element_count || vector->element_count > UINT32_MAX)
021100:     {
021101:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
021102:     }
021103:     value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, vector->element_type, source);
021104:     if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
021105:     {
021106:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
021107:     }
021108:     u32 count = (u32)vector->element_count;
021109:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, count);
021110:     for (u32 index = 0; index < count; index += 1)
021111:     {
021112:         operands[index] = value;
021113:     }
021114:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, vector_type);
021115:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
021116:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ARRAY, vector_type);
021117:     instruction.operands = operands;
021118:     instruction.operand_count = count;
021119:     instruction.result = result;
021120:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
021121:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
021122:     return result;
021123: }

021125: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_scalarize_binary16_vector_operation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrUnaryOperation unary, IrBinaryOperation binary,
021126:                                                                       IrValueId* operands, u32 operand_count, IrTypeId vector_type,
021127:                                                                       IrTypeId result_type, bool comparison, IrSourceRange source)
021128: {
021129:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
021130:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, vector_type);
021131:     IrType* result_vector = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, result_type);
021132:     bool valid = vector && result_vector && vector->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && result_vector->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR &&
021133:                  vector->element_count == result_vector->element_count && vector->element_count && vector->element_count <= UINT32_MAX &&
021134:                  operand_count && operand_count <= 2;
021135:     IrBinaryOperation scalar_binary = IR_BINARY_COUNT;
021136:     if (valid && binary != IR_BINARY_COUNT)
021137:     {
021138:         scalar_binary = binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_ADD             ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD
021139:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_SUBTRACT       ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT
021140:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_MULTIPLY       ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY
021141:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_DIVIDE         ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE
021142:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_EQUAL          ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL
021143:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL      ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL
021144:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_LESS           ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS
021145:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL     ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL
021146:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER        ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER
021147:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL  ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL
021148:                                                                            : IR_BINARY_COUNT;
021149:         valid = scalar_binary != IR_BINARY_COUNT;
021150:     }
021151:     if (valid && unary != IR_UNARY_COUNT)
021152:     {
021153:         valid = unary == IR_UNARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_NEGATE;
021154:     }
021155:     IrValueId* slots = valid ? arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, operand_count) : 0;
021156:     for (u32 operand_index = 0; valid && operand_index < operand_count; operand_index += 1)
021157:     {
021158:         slots[operand_index] = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, vector_type, source);
021159:         valid = slots[operand_index].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
021160:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slots[operand_index], vector_type, operands[operand_index], source);
021161:     }
021162:     u32 lane_count = valid ? (u32)vector->element_count : 0;
021163:     IrValueId* lanes = valid ? arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, lane_count) : 0;
021164:     for (u32 lane_index = 0; valid && lane_index < lane_count; lane_index += 1)
021165:     {
021166:         IrValueId lane_number = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, lane_index, false, (CToken){0}, builder->s32_type);
021167:         IrValueId lane_values[2] = {IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID};
021168:         valid = lane_number.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
021169:         for (u32 operand_index = 0; valid && operand_index < operand_count; operand_index += 1)
021170:         {
021171:             IrValueId lane_place = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, slots[operand_index], lane_number, source);
021172:             lane_values[operand_index] = lane_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
021173:                                              ? c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, lane_place, vector->element_type, source)
021174:                                              : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
021175:             valid = lane_values[operand_index].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
021176:         }
021177:         IrValueId lane_result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
021178:         if (valid && unary != IR_UNARY_COUNT)

021180:             lane_result = c_ir_emit_unary_value(builder, lane_values[0], vector->element_type, IR_UNARY_FLOAT_NEGATE, source);
021181:         }

021194:                               ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, all_bits, result_vector->element_type, source)
021195:                               : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
021196:         }
021197:         valid = lane_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
021198:         if (valid)
021199:         {
021200:             lanes[lane_index] = lane_result;
021201:         }
021202:     }
021203:     if (valid)
021204:     {
021205:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, result_type);
021206:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ARRAY, result_type);
021207:         instruction.operands = lanes;
021208:         instruction.operand_count = lane_count;
021209:         instruction.result = result;
021210:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
021211:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
021212:     }
021213:     return result;
021214: }
