022751: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, CConditionalOperator operation,
022752:                                                        IrValueId right, IrSourceRange source, IrValueId* previous_out, IrValueId* result_out)
022753: {
022754:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
022755:     bool atomic = place_type && place_type->is_atomic;
022756:     // The operation consumes an unqualified value even when the destination
022757:     // place is volatile. Loads and stores retain that place's access flags.
022758:     IrTypeId value_type = place_type && (atomic || place_type->is_volatile) ? place_type->unqualified_type : type;
022759:     IrType* unqualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
022760:     bool pointer_arithmetic = unqualified && unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_ADD || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT);
022761:     IrValueId previous = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
022762:     IrValueId operation_right = right;
022763:     if (pointer_arithmetic && atomic)
022764:     {
022765:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, unqualified->element_type);
022766:         right = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, right, builder->ptrdiff_type, source);
022767:         if (!element || !element->layout.resolved || !element->layout.size || right.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
022768:         {
022769:             return false;
022770:         }
022771:         IrValueId scale = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, element->layout.size, false, (CToken){0}, builder->ptrdiff_type);
022772:         right = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, right, scale, builder->ptrdiff_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
022773:     }
022774:     else if (!pointer_arithmetic && !c_ir_unsigned_bit_field_promotes_to_int(builder, c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place)))
022775:     {
022776:         right = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, right, value_type, source);
022777:         operation_right = right;
022778:     }
022779:     if (right.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
022780:     {
022781:         return false;
022782:     }
022783:     if (atomic && unqualified && unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
022784:     {
022785:         // No hardware has a floating-point atomic read-modify-write, so this
022786:         // one is a compare-exchange loop over the object's bit pattern rather
022787:         // than a single instruction.
022788:         return c_ir_emit_atomic_float_update(builder, place, type, value_type, operation, operation_right, source, previous_out, result_out);
022789:     }
022790:     if (atomic)
022791:     {
022792:         IrAtomicOperation atomic_operation = IR_ATOMIC_OPERATION_COUNT;
022793:         if (!unqualified || (unqualified->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && !pointer_arithmetic) || !c_ir_atomic_operation(operation, &atomic_operation))
022794:         {
022795:             return false;
022796:         }
022797:         previous = c_ir_add_result(builder, value_type);
022798:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
022799:         operands[0] = place;
022800:         operands[1] = right;
022801:         IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
022802:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_READ_MODIFY_WRITE, value_type);
022803:         instruction.operands = operands;
022804:         instruction.operand_count = 2;
022805:         instruction.memory_order = IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL;
022806:         instruction.atomic_operation = (u8)atomic_operation;
022807:         instruction.result = previous;
022808:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
022809:         builder->function->values[previous.value].definition = id;
022810:     }
022811:     else
022812:     {
022813:         previous = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, type, source);
022814:     }
022815:     IrValueId values[2] = {
022816:         previous,
022817:         operation_right,
022818:     };
022819:     u32 value_count = 2;
022820:     if (previous.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_apply_operation(builder, operation, values, &value_count, source, value_type) || value_count != 1 ||
022821:         (!atomic && !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, place, type, values[0], source)))
022822:     {
022823:         return false;
022824:     }
022825:     if (previous_out)
022826:     {
022827:         *previous_out = previous;
022828:     }
022829:     if (result_out)
022830:     {
022831:         // The value of `E op= x` is what E holds afterwards, in E's own type.
022832:         // The operation runs in the promoted type, so a narrower object's
022833:         // result comes back down here -- `(data[i] += 2) == 0` has to see the
022834:         // stored byte, not the 256 the addition produced.
022835:         if (!atomic && values[0].value < builder->function->value_count &&
022836:             builder->function->values[values[0].value].canonical_type.value != value_type.value)
022837:         {
022838:             values[0] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[0], value_type, source);
022839:             if (values[0].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
022840:             {
022841:                 return false;
022842:             }
022843:         }
022844:         *result_out = c_ir_bit_field_assignment_value(builder, place, values[0], source);
022845:     }
022846:     return true;
022847: }

022849: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_compound_assignment_operator(CToken token, CConditionalOperator* operation)
022850: {
022851:     if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR)
022852:     {
022853:         return false;
022854:     }
022855:     switch (token.punctuator)
022856:     {
022857:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR_ASSIGN:
022858:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY;
022859:         return true;
022860:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_SLASH_ASSIGN:
022861:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE;
022862:         return true;
022863:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_PERCENT_ASSIGN:
022864:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_REMAINDER;
022865:         return true;
022866:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_ASSIGN:
022867:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_ADD;
022868:         return true;
022869:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_ASSIGN:
022870:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT;
022871:         return true;
022872:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_LEFT_ASSIGN:
022873:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_LEFT;
022874:         return true;
022875:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_RIGHT_ASSIGN:
022876:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_RIGHT;
022877:         return true;
022878:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND_ASSIGN:
022879:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_AND;
022880:         return true;
022881:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_CARET_ASSIGN:
022882:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_XOR;
022883:         return true;
022884:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_PIPE_ASSIGN:
022885:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_OR;
022886:         return true;
022887:     default:
022888:         return false;
022889:     }
022890: }

023751:     {
023752:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
023753:     }
023754:     return result.result_type;
023755: }

023757: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_increment(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrValueId previous, CToken token, bool prefix)
023758: {
023759:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 1, false, token);
023760:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
023761:     if (place_type && place_type->is_atomic)
023762:     {
023763:         IrValueId atomic_previous = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023764:         IrValueId atomic_result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023765:         if (!c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(builder, place, type,
023766:                                            c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD : C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, one,
023767:                                            c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token), &atomic_previous, &atomic_result))
023768:         {
023769:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023770:         }
023771:         return prefix ? atomic_result : atomic_previous;
023772:     }
023773:     IrValueId values[2] = {
023774:         previous,
023775:         one,
023776:     };
023777:     u32 value_count = 2;
023778:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
023779:     if (!c_ir_apply_operation(builder, c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD : C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, values, &value_count,
023780:                               source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) ||
023781:         value_count != 1 || !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, place, type, values[0], source))
023782:     {
023783:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023784:     }
023785:     if (prefix && values[0].value < builder->function->value_count && builder->function->values[values[0].value].canonical_type.value != type.value)
023786:     {
023787:         // `++E` has the value E holds after the store, which is the value in
023788:         // E's own type: the addition ran in the promoted type, so a narrower
023789:         // object's result has to come back down before anything reads it.
023790:         // SQLite carries its page-header cell count into the high byte with
023791:         // `if( (++data[hdr+4])==0 ) data[hdr+3]++;`, and that carry is lost
023792:         // when the comparison sees 256 instead of 0.
023793:         values[0] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[0], type, source);
023794:     }
023795:     return prefix ? c_ir_bit_field_assignment_value(builder, place, values[0], source) : c_ir_vla_pointer_rvalue(builder, previous, source);
023796: }

023798: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_postfix_update_at(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 index, u32 end)
023799: {
023800:     return index + 1 < end && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ||
023801:                                c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS));
023802: }

023804: // Aggregate operands are captured values, while volatile qualifiers belong to
023805: // their destination places. If a conversion retained the unqualified value,
023806: // initialize explicit storage through the ordinary qualified STORE contract.
023807: // Keep exact constructor typing and evaluate each initializer only once.
023808: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_initializer_capture(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id, IrValueId* operands,
023809:                                                         u64* fields, u32 count, IrSourceRange source)
023810: {
023811:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
023812:     bool array = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR;
023813:     bool storage = false;
023814:     for (u32 index = 0; index < count && !storage; index += 1)
023815:     {
023816:         IrTypeId field_type = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[fields[index]].type;
023817:         IrTypeId operand_type = builder->function->values[operands[index].value].canonical_type;
023818:         storage = operand_type.value != field_type.value &&
023819:                   ir_types_differ_only_in_volatile(&builder->program->types, operand_type, field_type);
023820:     }
023821:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023822:     if (storage)
023823:     {
023824:         IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, type_id, source);
023825:         bool valid = place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
023826:         for (u32 index = 0; index < count && valid; index += 1)
023827:         {
023828:             IrValueId field;
023829:             if (array)
023830:             {
023831:                 IrValueId offset = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, index, false, (CToken){0}, builder->size_type);
023832:                 field = offset.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, place, offset, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023833:             }
023834:             else
023835:             {
023836:                 field = c_ir_emit_field_index_place(builder, place, (u32)fields[index], source);
023837:             }
023838:             IrTypeId field_type = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[fields[index]].type;
023839:             valid = field.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, field, field_type, operands[index], source);
023840:         }
023841:         if (valid)
023842:         {
023843:             result = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, type_id, source);
023844:         }
023845:     }
023846:     else
023847:     {
023848:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type_id);
023849:         if (result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
023850:         {
023851:             IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(array ? IR_OPCODE_ARRAY : IR_OPCODE_AGGREGATE, type_id);
023852:             instruction.operands = operands;
023853:             instruction.operand_count = count;
023854:             instruction.immediates = fields;
023855:             instruction.immediate_count = array ? 0 : (u16)count;
023856:             instruction.result = result;
023857:             IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
023858:             builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
023859:         }
023860:     }
023861:     return result;
023862: }

023866: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_zero_storage_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId root)
023867: {
023868:     IrType* root_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, root);
023869:     bool compatible = root_type && root_type->layout.resolved && root_type->layout.size >= C_IR_BOUNDED_ZERO_STORAGE_MIN_BYTES &&
023870:                       (root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION);
023871:     if (compatible)
023872:     {
023873:         u32 capacity = builder->program->types.count;
023874:         IrTypeId* pending = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, IrTypeId, capacity);
023875:         u8* seen = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, u8, capacity);
023876:         memset(seen, 0, capacity);
023877:         u32 count = 1;
023878:         pending[0] = root;
023879:         seen[root.value] = 1;
023880:         for (u32 index = 0; compatible && index < count; index += 1)
023881:         {
023882:             IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pending[index]);
023883:             compatible = type && type->layout.resolved && !type->is_atomic && !type->is_volatile;
023884:             if (compatible)
023885:             {
023886:                 bool array = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR;
023887:                 bool record = type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION;
023888:                 compatible = array || record || type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ||
023889:                              type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
023890:                 u32 children = array ? 1 : record ? type->field_count : 0;
023891:                 for (u32 child = 0; compatible && child < children; child += 1)
023892:                 {
023893:                     IrTypeId id = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[child].type;
023894:                     compatible = id.value < capacity;
023895:                     if (compatible && !seen[id.value])
023896:                     {
023897:                         seen[id.value] = 1;
023898:                         pending[count++] = id;
023899:                     }
023900:                 }
023901:             }
023902:         }
023903:     }
023904:     return compatible;
023905: }

023907: // Large aggregate zero initialization must not expand into one canonical
023908: // value and spill slot per byte. Windows ARM64 unwind records cannot describe
023909: // the multi-megabyte functions that expansion produces. Check representations
023910: // and qualifiers before using a byte loop; this introduces no libc dependency.
023911: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_zero_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type_id,
023912:                                              u64 count, CToken token)
023913: {
023914:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
023915:     IrTypeId element_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR);
023916:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, element_type);
023917:     IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type_id, source);
023918:     IrValueId array = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source);
023919:     IrValueId cursor = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, builder->size_type, source);
023920:     IrValueId initial = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->size_type);
023921:     IrValueId limit = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, count, false, token, builder->size_type);
023922:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, builder->size_type);
023923:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, element_type);
023924:     IrBlockId body = c_ir_block_create(builder);
023925:     IrBlockId done = c_ir_block_create(builder);
023926:     bool valid = array.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && cursor.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023927:                  initial.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && limit.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023928:                  one.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023929:                  body.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && done.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
023930:     valid = valid && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, initial, source) &&
023931:             c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &body, 1, source) && c_ir_switch_block(builder, body);
023932:     if (valid)
023933:     {
023934:         IrValueId index = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, source);
023935:         IrValueId element = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, array, index, source);
023936:         IrValueId next = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, index, one, builder->size_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
023937:         IrValueId finished = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, next, limit, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_EQUAL, source);
023938:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {done, body};
023939:         valid = index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && element.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023940:                 next.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && finished.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023941:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, element, element_type, zero, source) &&
023942:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, next, source) &&
023943:                 c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &finished, 1, targets, 2, source) &&
023944:                 c_ir_switch_block(builder, done);
023945:     }
023946:     return valid;
023947: }

023936:         IrValueId next = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, index, one, builder->size_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);

023938:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {done, body};

023940:                 next.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && finished.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&

023944:                 c_ir_switch_block(builder, done);

023864: #define C_IR_BOUNDED_ZERO_STORAGE_MIN_BYTES 4096u
023865: 
023866: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_zero_storage_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId root)
023867: {
023868:     IrType* root_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, root);
023869:     bool compatible = root_type && root_type->layout.resolved && root_type->layout.size >= C_IR_BOUNDED_ZERO_STORAGE_MIN_BYTES &&
023870:                       (root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION);
023871:     if (compatible)
023872:     {
023873:         u32 capacity = builder->program->types.count;
023874:         IrTypeId* pending = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, IrTypeId, capacity);
023875:         u8* seen = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, u8, capacity);
023876:         memset(seen, 0, capacity);
023877:         u32 count = 1;
023878:         pending[0] = root;
023879:         seen[root.value] = 1;
023880:         for (u32 index = 0; compatible && index < count; index += 1)
023881:         {
023882:             IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pending[index]);
023883:             compatible = type && type->layout.resolved && !type->is_atomic && !type->is_volatile;
023884:             if (compatible)
023885:             {
023886:                 bool array = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR;
023887:                 bool record = type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION;
023888:                 compatible = array || record || type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ||
023889:                              type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
023890:                 u32 children = array ? 1 : record ? type->field_count : 0;
023891:                 for (u32 child = 0; compatible && child < children; child += 1)
023892:                 {
023893:                     IrTypeId id = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[child].type;
023894:                     compatible = id.value < capacity;
023895:                     if (compatible && !seen[id.value])
023896:                     {
023897:                         seen[id.value] = 1;
023898:                         pending[count++] = id;
023899:                     }
023900:                 }
023901:             }
023902:         }
023903:     }
023904:     return compatible;
023905: }
023906: 
023907: // Large aggregate zero initialization must not expand into one canonical
023908: // value and spill slot per byte. Windows ARM64 unwind records cannot describe
023909: // the multi-megabyte functions that expansion produces. Check representations
023910: // and qualifiers before using a byte loop; this introduces no libc dependency.
023911: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_zero_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type_id,
023912:                                              u64 count, CToken token)
023913: {
023914:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
023915:     IrTypeId element_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR);
023916:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, element_type);
023917:     IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type_id, source);
023918:     IrValueId array = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source);
023919:     IrValueId cursor = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, builder->size_type, source);
023920:     IrValueId initial = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->size_type);
023921:     IrValueId limit = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, count, false, token, builder->size_type);
023922:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, builder->size_type);
023923:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, element_type);
023924:     IrBlockId body = c_ir_block_create(builder);
023925:     IrBlockId done = c_ir_block_create(builder);
023926:     bool valid = array.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && cursor.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023927:                  initial.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && limit.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023928:                  one.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023929:                  body.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && done.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
023930:     valid = valid && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, initial, source) &&
023931:             c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &body, 1, source) && c_ir_switch_block(builder, body);
023932:     if (valid)
023933:     {
023934:         IrValueId index = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, source);
023935:         IrValueId element = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, array, index, source);
023936:         IrValueId next = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, index, one, builder->size_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
023937:         IrValueId finished = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, next, limit, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_EQUAL, source);
023938:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {done, body};
023939:         valid = index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && element.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023940:                 next.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && finished.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023941:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, element, element_type, zero, source) &&
023942:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, next, source) &&
023943:                 c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &finished, 1, targets, 2, source) &&
023944:                 c_ir_switch_block(builder, done);
023945:     }
023946:     return valid;
023947: }

023942:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, next, source) &&
023943:                 c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &finished, 1, targets, 2, source) &&
023944:                 c_ir_switch_block(builder, done);
023945:     }
023946:     return valid;
023947: }
023948: 
023949: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_zero_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId root_type, CToken token)
023950: {
023951:     typedef enum CIrZeroTaskKind
023952:     {
023953:         C_IR_ZERO_TASK_VALUE,
023954:         C_IR_ZERO_TASK_COMPLETE,
023955:     } CIrZeroTaskKind;
023956:     typedef struct CIrZeroTask CIrZeroTask;
023957:     struct CIrZeroTask
023958:     {
023959:         IrValueId* output;
023960:         IrValueId* operands;
023961:         u64* fields;
023962:         IrTypeId type;
023963:         u32 operand_count;
023964:         CIrZeroTaskKind kind;
023965:     };
023966:     IrType* root = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, root_type);
023967:     if (!root || !root->layout.resolved || root->layout.size > (UINT32_MAX - 64) / 8)
023968:     {
023969:         builder->failure_message = !root                    ? S8("cannot zero-initialize an unresolved IR type")
023970:                                    : !root->layout.resolved ? S8("cannot zero-initialize an aggregate with unresolved layout")
023971:                                                             : S8("aggregate is too large to zero-initialize");
023972:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023973:     }
023974:     u32 capacity = (u32)(root->layout.size * 8 + 64);
023975:     CIrZeroTask* tasks = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrZeroTask, capacity);
023976:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023977:     u32 task_count = 1;
023978:     tasks[0] = (CIrZeroTask){
023979:         .output = &result,
023980:         .type = root_type,
023981:     };
023982:     while (task_count)
023983:     {
023984:         CIrZeroTask task = tasks[--task_count];
023985:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, task.type);
023986:         if (!type)
023987:         {
023988:             builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("cannot zero-initialize unresolved IR type {u32}"), task.type.value);
023989:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023990:         }
023991:         if (task.kind == C_IR_ZERO_TASK_COMPLETE)
023992:         {
023993:             if (type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && type->kind != IR_TYPE_VECTOR && task.operand_count > UINT16_MAX)
023994:             {
023995:                 builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("aggregate has too many fields to lower ({u32})"), task.operand_count);
023996:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
023997:             }
023998:             IrSourceRange instruction_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
023999:             IrValueId aggregate = c_ir_emit_initializer_capture(builder, task.type, task.operands, task.fields, task.operand_count, instruction_source);
024000:             if (aggregate.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
024001:             {
024002:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
024003:             }
024004:             *task.output = aggregate;
024005:             continue;
024006:         }
024007:         bool aggregate = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR || type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION;
024008:         if (!aggregate)
024009:         {
024010:             IrValueId zero = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
024011:             if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
024012:             {
024013:                 if (type->bit_width == 80)
024014:                 {
024015:                     // The f80 constant carries the semantic ten bytes as two
024016:                     // integer immediates; do not route synthetic zero through
024017:                     // a host f64 literal or a generic floating conversion.
024018:                     zero = c_ir_emit_f80_constant_bits(builder, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token), S8("0.0L"), 0, 0);
024019:                 }
024020:                 else
024021:                 {
024022:                     CToken zero_token = {
024023:                         .offset = C_SPELLING_FLOAT_ZERO,
024024:                         .length = type->bit_width == 32 ? 4u : 3u,
024025:                         .kind = C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER,
024026:                     };
024027:                     zero = c_ir_emit_float(builder, zero_token);
024028:                     zero = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, zero, task.type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
024029:                 }
024030:             }
024031:             else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
024032:             {
024033:                 zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, task.type);
024034:             }
024035:             else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
024036:             {
024037:                 zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
024038:                 zero = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, zero, task.type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
024039:             }
024040:             else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
024041:             {
024042:                 zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);

023843:             result = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, type_id, source);
023844:         }
023845:     }
023846:     else
023847:     {
023848:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type_id);
023849:         if (result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
023850:         {
023851:             IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(array ? IR_OPCODE_ARRAY : IR_OPCODE_AGGREGATE, type_id);
023852:             instruction.operands = operands;
023853:             instruction.operand_count = count;
023854:             instruction.immediates = fields;
023855:             instruction.immediate_count = array ? 0 : (u16)count;
023856:             instruction.result = result;
023857:             IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
023858:             builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
023859:         }
023860:     }
023861:     return result;
023862: }
023863: 
023864: #define C_IR_BOUNDED_ZERO_STORAGE_MIN_BYTES 4096u
023865: 
023866: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_zero_storage_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId root)
023867: {
023868:     IrType* root_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, root);
023869:     bool compatible = root_type && root_type->layout.resolved && root_type->layout.size >= C_IR_BOUNDED_ZERO_STORAGE_MIN_BYTES &&
023870:                       (root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION);
023871:     if (compatible)
023872:     {
023873:         u32 capacity = builder->program->types.count;
023874:         IrTypeId* pending = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, IrTypeId, capacity);
023875:         u8* seen = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, u8, capacity);
023876:         memset(seen, 0, capacity);
023877:         u32 count = 1;
023878:         pending[0] = root;
023879:         seen[root.value] = 1;
023880:         for (u32 index = 0; compatible && index < count; index += 1)
023881:         {
023882:             IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pending[index]);
023883:             compatible = type && type->layout.resolved && !type->is_atomic && !type->is_volatile;
023884:             if (compatible)
023885:             {
023886:                 bool array = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR;
023887:                 bool record = type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION;
023888:                 compatible = array || record || type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ||
023889:                              type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
023890:                 u32 children = array ? 1 : record ? type->field_count : 0;
023891:                 for (u32 child = 0; compatible && child < children; child += 1)
023892:                 {
023893:                     IrTypeId id = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[child].type;
023894:                     compatible = id.value < capacity;
023895:                     if (compatible && !seen[id.value])
023896:                     {
023897:                         seen[id.value] = 1;
023898:                         pending[count++] = id;
023899:                     }
023900:                 }
023901:             }
023902:         }
023903:     }
023904:     return compatible;
023905: }
023906: 
023907: // Large aggregate zero initialization must not expand into one canonical
023908: // value and spill slot per byte. Windows ARM64 unwind records cannot describe
023909: // the multi-megabyte functions that expansion produces. Check representations
023910: // and qualifiers before using a byte loop; this introduces no libc dependency.
023911: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_zero_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type_id,
023912:                                              u64 count, CToken token)
023913: {
023914:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
023915:     IrTypeId element_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR);
023916:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, element_type);
023917:     IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type_id, source);
023918:     IrValueId array = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source);
023919:     IrValueId cursor = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, builder->size_type, source);
023920:     IrValueId initial = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->size_type);
023921:     IrValueId limit = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, count, false, token, builder->size_type);
023922:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, builder->size_type);
023923:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, element_type);
023924:     IrBlockId body = c_ir_block_create(builder);
023925:     IrBlockId done = c_ir_block_create(builder);
023926:     bool valid = array.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && cursor.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023927:                  initial.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && limit.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023928:                  one.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023929:                  body.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && done.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
023930:     valid = valid && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, initial, source) &&
023931:             c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &body, 1, source) && c_ir_switch_block(builder, body);
023932:     if (valid)
023933:     {
023934:         IrValueId index = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, source);
023935:         IrValueId element = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, array, index, source);
023936:         IrValueId next = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, index, one, builder->size_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
023937:         IrValueId finished = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, next, limit, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_EQUAL, source);
023938:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {done, body};
023939:         valid = index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && element.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023940:                 next.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && finished.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
023941:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, element, element_type, zero, source) &&
023942:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, next, source) &&
023943:                 c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &finished, 1, targets, 2, source) &&
023944:                 c_ir_switch_block(builder, done);
023945:     }
023946:     return valid;
023947: }

024090: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(Arena* arena, CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, u64* value_out);
024091: 
024092: // A designator is a chain, not one step: C11 6.7.9p6 lets `.member`, `[index]`
024093: // and any mix of them follow one another before the `=`. musl's mutex,
024094: // barrier and rlimit initializers all write one -- `._m_type` is
024095: // `__u.__i[0]` after the header's macros -- so the walk below accepts both
024096: // step kinds and stops at the first token that is neither. It returns the
024097: // index of the token after the last step, which the caller checks is the `=`.
024098: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_designator_chain_end(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end)
024099: {
024100:     u32 index = start;
024101:     while (index < end)
024102:     {
024103:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) && index + 1 < end &&
024104:             builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
024105:         {
024106:             index += 2;
024107:             continue;
024108:         }
024109:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
024110:         {
024111:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
024112:             if (close >= end || close == index + 1)
024113:             {
024114:                 break;
024115:             }
024116:             index = close + 1;
024117:             continue;
024118:         }
024119:         break;
024120:     }
024121: 
024122:     return index;
024123: }
024124: 
024125: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_array_designator_has_range(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 close)
024126: {
024127:     for (u32 index = start + 1; index < close; index += 1)
024128:     {
024129:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_ELLIPSIS))
024130:         {
024131:             return true;
024132:         }
024133:     }
024134:     return false;
024135: }

024137: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_string_array_element_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId element_type, CIrDecodedString decoded);
024138: 
024139: // Unnamed bit-fields are padding, while anonymous structs/unions still consume
024140: // an initializer. Keep the cursor in field indices so each padding field is
024141: // skipped once as a positional initializer advances.
024142: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_initializer_next_field_index(IrType* type, u32 index)
024143: {
024144:     while (index < type->field_count && type->fields[index].is_bit_field && !type->fields[index].name.length)
024145:     {
024146:         index += 1;
024147:     }
024148:     return index;
024149: }

028282: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_truth_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
028283: {
028284:     IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
028285:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
028286:     if (!type)
028287:     {
028288:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028289:     }
028290:     // Array expressions decay to pointers in every value context, including
028291:     // the truth conversion of an assertion's `condition && "message"`
028292:     // operand.  Keep the declared array type for sizeof/type-only queries,
028293:     // but materialize its address before forming the pointer comparison here.
028294:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
028295:     {
028296:         IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
028297:         value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
028298:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
028299:         {
028300:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028301:         }
028302:         type_id = pointer_type;
028303:         type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
028304:         if (!type)
028305:         {
028306:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028307:         }
028308:     }
028309:     if (c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, type_id))
028310:     {
028311:         IrValueId widened = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, value, type_id, source);
028312:         return widened.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_truth_value(builder, widened, source);
028313:     }
028314:     // Truth conversion is a comparison against a zero of the same type, so it
028315:     // needs the x87 comparison the canonical backend provides only for f80.
028316:     // A wide long double on any other target still has none.
028317:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && type->bit_width > 64 && !c_ir_target_supports_f80(builder->target))
028318:     {
028319:         builder->failure_message = S8("C IR lowering does not yet support wide floating-point truth conversion");
028320:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028321:     }
028322:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
028323:     {
028324:         return value;
028325:     }
028326:     // A complex value is false only when both halves are zero (C11 6.3.1.2
028327:     // applied to G.4.1's model), so the conversion is `re != 0 || im != 0`.
028328:     if (type->is_complex)
028329:     {
028330:         IrTypeId element = type->element_type;
028331:         IrValueId real = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028332:         IrValueId imaginary = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028333:         IrValueId zero = c_ir_complex_zero(builder, element, source);
028334:         if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_complex_split(builder, value, &real, &imaginary, source))
028335:         {
028336:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028337:         }
028338:         IrValueId real_nonzero = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, real, zero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
028339:         IrValueId imaginary_nonzero = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, imaginary, zero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
028340:         return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, real_nonzero, imaginary_nonzero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_BOOLEAN_OR, source);
028341:     }
028342:     if (type->is_nullptr)
028343:     {
028344:         return c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, builder->bool_type);
028345:     }
028346:     // A pointer's zero is built at pointer width for the reason
028347:     // c_ir_emit_nullptr gives: it saves the widening cast on the hottest
028348:     // conversion in the language.
028349:     IrTypeId zero_type = type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? builder->size_type : builder->s32_type;
028350:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, zero_type);
028351:     if (zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && type_id.value != zero_type.value)
028352:     {
028353:         IrType* integer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->s32_type);
028354:         IrConversionOperation conversion = IR_CONVERSION_COUNT;
028355:         if (integer_type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
028356:         {
028357:             conversion = integer_type->bit_width < type->bit_width
028358:                              ? (integer_type->is_signed ? IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_SIGN_EXTEND : IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_ZERO_EXTEND)
028359:                          : integer_type->bit_width > type->bit_width ? IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_TRUNCATE
028360:                                                                     : IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_REINTERPRET;
028361:         }
028362:         else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
028363:         {
028364:             conversion = IR_CONVERSION_SIGNED_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
028365:         }
028366:         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
028367:         {
028368:             zero = c_ir_emit_integer_to_pointer(builder, zero, type_id, source);
028369:         }
028370:         else
028371:         {
028372:             zero = conversion == IR_CONVERSION_COUNT ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID
028373:                                                      : c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, zero, type_id, conversion, source);
028374:         }
028375:     }
028376:     if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
028377:     {
028378:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028379:     }
028380:     IrBinaryOperation operation = type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER   ? IR_BINARY_INTEGER_NOT_EQUAL
028381:                                   : type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT   ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL
028382:                                   : type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? IR_BINARY_POINTER_NOT_EQUAL
028383:                                                                   : IR_BINARY_COUNT;
028384:     if (operation == IR_BINARY_COUNT)
028385:     {
028386:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028387:     }
028388:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, builder->bool_type);
028389:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
028390:     operands[0] = value;
028391:     operands[1] = zero;
028392:     IrSourceRange comparison_source = source;
028393:     IrInstruction comparison = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_BINARY, builder->bool_type);
028394:     comparison.operands = operands;
028395:     comparison.operand_count = 2;
028396:     comparison.binary_operation = (u8)operation;
028397:     comparison.result = result;
028398:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, comparison, comparison_source);
028399:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
028400:     return result;
028401: }

028417: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_condition_leaf_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
028418: {
028419:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
028420:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
028421:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
028422:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_CONDITION_LEAF);
028423:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_PLACE)
028424:     {
028425:         IrValueId place = machine->child_result.value;
028426:         if (!machine->child_result.success || place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
028427:         {
028428:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
028429:             return;
028430:         }
028431:         frame->as.condition_leaf.place = place;
028432:         frame->as.condition_leaf.type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
028433:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_ASSIGNMENT;
028434:         if (!c_ir_lower_expression_core_frame_push(builder, frame->as.condition_leaf.start, frame->as.condition_leaf.end))
028435:         {
028436:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
028437:         }
028438:         return;
028439:     }
028440:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_CORE)
028441:     {
028442:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, machine->child_result.success, machine->child_result.value);
028443:         return;
028444:     }
028445:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_ASSIGNMENT)
028446:     {
028447:         IrValueId value = machine->child_result.value;
028448:         IrValueId place = frame->as.condition_leaf.place;
028449:         IrTypeId type = frame->as.condition_leaf.type;
028450:         IrSourceRange source = frame->as.condition_leaf.source;
028451:         if (!machine->child_result.success || place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
028452:         {
028453:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
028454:             return;
028455:         }
028456:         if (!frame->as.condition_leaf.simple)
028457:         {
028458:             bool success = c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(builder, place, type, frame->as.condition_leaf.operation, value, source, 0, &value);
028459:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, value);
028460:             return;
028461:         }
028462:         value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, type, source);
028463:         value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, type, source);
028464:         bool success = value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, place, type, value, source);
===== line 28350 =====
028270:         memcpy(instruction.targets, targets, sizeof(IrBlockId) * target_count);
028271:         instruction.target_count = (u16)target_count;
028272:     }
028273:     if (c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
028274:     {
028275:         return false;
028276:     }
028277:     block = &builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value];
028278:     block->terminated = true;
028279:     return true;
028280: }
028281: 
028282: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_truth_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
028283: {
028284:     IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
028285:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
028286:     if (!type)
028287:     {
028288:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028289:     }
028290:     // Array expressions decay to pointers in every value context, including
028291:     // the truth conversion of an assertion's `condition && "message"`
028292:     // operand.  Keep the declared array type for sizeof/type-only queries,
028293:     // but materialize its address before forming the pointer comparison here.
028294:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
028295:     {
028296:         IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
028297:         value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
028298:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
028299:         {
028300:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028301:         }
028302:         type_id = pointer_type;
028303:         type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
028304:         if (!type)
028305:         {
028306:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028307:         }
028308:     }
028309:     if (c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, type_id))
028310:     {
028311:         IrValueId widened = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, value, type_id, source);
028312:         return widened.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_truth_value(builder, widened, source);
028313:     }
028314:     // Truth conversion is a comparison against a zero of the same type, so it
028315:     // needs the x87 comparison the canonical backend provides only for f80.
028316:     // A wide long double on any other target still has none.
028317:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && type->bit_width > 64 && !c_ir_target_supports_f80(builder->target))
028318:     {
028319:         builder->failure_message = S8("C IR lowering does not yet support wide floating-point truth conversion");
028320:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028321:     }
028322:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
028323:     {
028324:         return value;
028325:     }
028326:     // A complex value is false only when both halves are zero (C11 6.3.1.2
028327:     // applied to G.4.1's model), so the conversion is `re != 0 || im != 0`.
028328:     if (type->is_complex)
028329:     {
028330:         IrTypeId element = type->element_type;
028331:         IrValueId real = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028332:         IrValueId imaginary = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028333:         IrValueId zero = c_ir_complex_zero(builder, element, source);
028334:         if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_complex_split(builder, value, &real, &imaginary, source))
028335:         {
028336:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028337:         }
028338:         IrValueId real_nonzero = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, real, zero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
028339:         IrValueId imaginary_nonzero = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, imaginary, zero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
028340:         return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, real_nonzero, imaginary_nonzero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_BOOLEAN_OR, source);
028341:     }
028342:     if (type->is_nullptr)
028343:     {
028344:         return c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, builder->bool_type);
028345:     }
028346:     // A pointer's zero is built at pointer width for the reason
028347:     // c_ir_emit_nullptr gives: it saves the widening cast on the hottest
028348:     // conversion in the language.
028349:     IrTypeId zero_type = type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? builder->size_type : builder->s32_type;
028350:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, zero_type);
028351:     if (zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && type_id.value != zero_type.value)
028352:     {
028353:         IrType* integer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->s32_type);
028354:         IrConversionOperation conversion = IR_CONVERSION_COUNT;
028355:         if (integer_type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
028356:         {
028357:             conversion = integer_type->bit_width < type->bit_width
028358:                              ? (integer_type->is_signed ? IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_SIGN_EXTEND : IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_ZERO_EXTEND)
028359:                          : integer_type->bit_width > type->bit_width ? IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_TRUNCATE
028360:                                                                     : IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_REINTERPRET;
028361:         }
028362:         else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
028363:         {
028364:             conversion = IR_CONVERSION_SIGNED_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
028365:         }
028366:         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
028367:         {
028368:             zero = c_ir_emit_integer_to_pointer(builder, zero, type_id, source);
028369:         }
028370:         else
028371:         {
028372:             zero = conversion == IR_CONVERSION_COUNT ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID
028373:                                                      : c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, zero, type_id, conversion, source);
028374:         }
028375:     }
028376:     if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
028377:     {
028378:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028379:     }
028380:     IrBinaryOperation operation = type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER   ? IR_BINARY_INTEGER_NOT_EQUAL
028381:                                   : type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT   ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL
028382:                                   : type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? IR_BINARY_POINTER_NOT_EQUAL
028383:                                                                   : IR_BINARY_COUNT;
028384:     if (operation == IR_BINARY_COUNT)
028385:     {
028386:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
028387:     }
028388:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, builder->bool_type);
028389:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
028390:     operands[0] = value;
028391:     operands[1] = zero;
028392:     IrSourceRange comparison_source = source;
028393:     IrInstruction comparison = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_BINARY, builder->bool_type);
028394:     comparison.operands = operands;
028395:     comparison.operand_count = 2;
028396:     comparison.binary_operation = (u8)operation;
028397:     comparison.result = result;
028398:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, comparison, comparison_source);
028399:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
028400:     return result;
028401: }

029163: // The request helpers run the pushed child now, off the dispatch loop, and
029164: // return true when it completed: the advance loop in
029165: // c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_step then re-enters the CHILD arm as a
029166: // self-loop instead of a dispatch round trip. A suspension returns false and
029167: // resumes through the loop unchanged.
029168: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
029169:                                                                               CIrLowerAssignmentStatementState* state,
029170:                                                                               CIrLowerAssignmentStatementContinuation continuation, u32 start,
029171:                                                                               u32 end)
029172: {
029173:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
029174:     state->continuation = continuation;
029175:     state->temporary_mark = builder->temporary_arena->position;
029176:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
029177:     u32 request_mark = machine->frame_count;
029178:     bool completed = false;
029179:     if (c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
029180:                                            .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION,
029181:                                            .as.expression =
029182:                                                {
029183:                                                    .start = start,
029184:                                                    .end = end,
029185:                                                },
029186:                                        }))
029187:     {
029188:         c_ir_lower_expression_step(builder);
029189:         completed = machine->frame_count == request_mark && !machine->failed;
029190:     }
029191:     return completed;
029192: }

029194: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,

029083:         if (result->dimension_counts[dimension].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
029084:         {
029085:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
029086:             return;
029087:         }
029088:         state->dimension += 1;
029089:         frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
029090:     }
029091:     while (state->dimension < result->dimension_count)
029092:     {
029093:         u32 dimension = state->dimension;
029094:         CArrayBound bound = c_ir_vla_bound_expression(builder->preprocess, state->bounds[dimension]);
029095:         u64 constant_count = 0;
029096:         if (c_ir_array_bound_evaluate(builder, bound, &constant_count))
029097:         {
029098:             result->dimension_counts[dimension] =

029100:             state->dimension += 1;
029101:             continue;
029102:         }
029103:         if (!bound.token_count || bound.is_star)
029104:         {
029105:             if (state->parameter && dimension == 0)
029106:             {
029107:                 state->dimension += 1;
029108:                 continue;
029109:             }
029110:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
029111:             return;
029112:         }
029113:         state->temporary_mark = builder->temporary_arena->position;
029114:         frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
029115:         c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
029116:                                            .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION,
029117:                                            .as.expression =
029118:                                                {
029119:                                                    .start = bound.token_start,
029120:                                                    .end = bound.token_start + bound.token_count,
029121:                                                },
029122:                                        });
029123:         return;
029124:     }
029125:     IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, result->element_type);
029126:     result->suffix_sizes[result->dimension_count] =
029127:         c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, element->layout.size, false, state->token, builder->size_type);
029128:     // suffix_sizes[0] is the whole object's size, and a parameter never has
029129:     // one: an array parameter is a pointer, so the only reader of
029130:     // CIrVlaLayout::runtime_size that wants suffix 0 is the ALLOCATE in
029131:     // c_ir_lower_automatic_declaration_step, which is the declaration path and
029132:     // not this one, and c_ir_lower_expression_core_step's sizeof arm refuses
029133:     // suffix 0 for an is_vla_parameter local on purpose, because `sizeof a` is
029134:     // the pointer's. Stopping the walk one dimension short therefore drops the
029135:     // outermost MULTIPLY — for a one-dimensional `u8 a[n]` that is the whole
029136:     // product, and unlike the constant bound `u8 slots[2]` the operands are not
029137:     // both known, so it cost emitted code rather than compile time. Every inner
029138:     // suffix is still built: `sizeof a[0]` on `u8 a[n][m]` reads
029139:     // suffix_sizes[1]. suffix_sizes[0] stays INVALID from the 0xff fill above,
029140:     // which is what an absent bound already left there and what the
029141:     // c_ir_lower_frame_finish below already accepts for a parameter.
029142:     u32 outermost_dimension = state->parameter ? 1 : 0;
029143:     for (u32 dimension = result->dimension_count; dimension != outermost_dimension; dimension -= 1)
029144:     {
029145:         u32 index = dimension - 1;
029146:         IrValueId count = result->dimension_counts[index];
029147:         IrValueId suffix = result->suffix_sizes[index + 1];
029148:         if (count.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && suffix.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
029149:         {
029150:             result->suffix_sizes[index] =
029151:                 c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, count, suffix, builder->size_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, state->source);
029152:         }
029153:     }
029154:     result->runtime_size = result->suffix_sizes[0];
029155:     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, state->parameter || result->runtime_size.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID, result->runtime_size);
029156: }

029163: // The request helpers run the pushed child now, off the dispatch loop, and
029164: // return true when it completed: the advance loop in
029165: // c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_step then re-enters the CHILD arm as a
029166: // self-loop instead of a dispatch round trip. A suspension returns false and

029169:                                                                               CIrLowerAssignmentStatementState* state,
029170:                                                                               CIrLowerAssignmentStatementContinuation continuation, u32 start,
029171:                                                                               u32 end)
029172: {

029179:     if (c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
029180:                                            .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION,
029181:                                            .as.expression =
029182:                                                {
029183:                                                    .start = start,
029184:                                                    .end = end,
029185:                                                },
029186:                                        }))
029187:     {
029188:         c_ir_lower_expression_step(builder);
029189:         completed = machine->frame_count == request_mark && !machine->failed;
029190:     }
029191:     return completed;
029192: }

029194: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,

029211: // Recover the addressable place behind a just-emitted load. Both ordinary
029212: // assignment statements and nested parenthesized assignment expressions use
029213: // this when their left operand was lowered as a value first (for example an
029214: // address-of/member chain in Lua's setnilvalue macro).
029215: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_recover_memory_place_from_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value)
029216: {
029217:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
029218:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
029219:     {
029220:         IrValue* value_definition = builder->function->values + value.value;
029221:         if (value_definition->category == IR_VALUE_PLACE)
029222:         {
029223:             result = value;
029224:         }
029225:         else if (value_definition->definition.value < builder->function->instruction_count)
029226:         {
029227:             IrInstructionId definition_id = value_definition->definition;
029228:             IrInstruction* definition = builder->function->instructions + definition_id.value;
029229:             CIrDirectSsa* ssa = builder->direct_ssa;
029230:             bool has_later_event = ssa && ssa->event_count && ssa->events[ssa->event_count - 1].after.value == definition_id.value;
029231:             bool recover = !has_later_event && (definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOAD || definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD) &&
029232:                            definition->operand_count == 1 && definition_id.value + 1 == builder->function->instruction_count &&
029233:                            value.value + 1 == builder->function->value_count &&
029234:                            builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value].last_instruction.value == definition_id.value &&
029235:                            builder->last_instruction.value == definition_id.value;
029236:             IrInstructionId previous = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID;
029237:             if (recover)
029238:             {
029239:                 if (builder->previous_instruction_known)
029240:                 {
029241:                     previous = builder->previous_instruction;
029242:                 }
029243:                 else
029244:                 {
029245:                     IrInstructionId cursor = builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value].first_instruction;
029246:                     while (cursor.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && cursor.value != definition_id.value)
029247:                     {

032475: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_activate_cleanup(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CEntityId entity_id, IrSourceRange source)
032476: {
032477:     if (entity_id.value >= builder->parse.entity_count || !builder->cleanup_flags || !builder->cleanup_entity_entries ||
032478:         !builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value].has_cleanup)
032479:     {
032480:         return true;
032481:     }
032482:     u32 cleanup_entry = builder->cleanup_entity_entries[entity_id.value];
032483:     if (cleanup_entry < builder->cleanup_flag_base || cleanup_entry - builder->cleanup_flag_base >= builder->cleanup_flag_count)
032484:     {
032485:         return true;
032486:     }
032487:     IrValueId flag = builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_entry - builder->cleanup_flag_base];
032488:     if (flag.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032489:     {
032490:         return false;
032491:     }
032492:     CToken token = c_ir_space_name_token(builder, builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value].name);
032493:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, builder->bool_type);
032494:     return value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, value, source);
032495: }

032551:         active = active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_truth_value(builder, active, source);

032553:         IrBlockId next_block = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032554:         if (active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || call_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || next_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032555:         {
032556:             return false;
032557:         }

032542:         bool callback_resolved = c_ir_cleanup_function_target(builder, entity->cleanup_function, &callback_function, &callback_signature);
032543:         IrTypeId variable_type = entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count ? builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value] : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
032544:         if (!callback_resolved || variable_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || callback_signature.parameter_count != 1)
032545:         {
032546:             return false;
032547:         }
032548:         CToken callback_token = c_ir_space_name_token(builder, entity->name);
032549:         IrValueId flag = builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index - 1];
032550:         IrValueId active = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, source);
032551:         active = active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_truth_value(builder, active, source);
032552:         IrBlockId call_block = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032553:         IrBlockId next_block = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032554:         if (active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || call_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || next_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032555:         {
032556:             return false;
032557:         }
032558:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {call_block, next_block};
032559:         if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &active, 1, targets, 2, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, call_block))
032560:         {
032561:             return false;
032562:         }
032563:         IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, local->place, variable_type, source);
032564:         IrValueId arguments[1] = {address};
032565:         arguments[0] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[0], callback_signature.parameter_types[0], source);
032566:         if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || arguments[0].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
032567:             c_ir_emit_call_target(builder, callback_token, callback_function, callback_signature, arguments, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(arguments)).value ==
032568:                 IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032569:         {
032570:             return false;
032571:         }
032572:         IrValueId inactive = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, callback_token, builder->bool_type);
032573:         if (inactive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, inactive, source) ||
032574:             !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &next_block, 1, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, next_block))
032575:         {
032576:             return false;
032577:         }
032578:     }
032579:     BUSTER_UNUSED(tasks);
032580:     BUSTER_UNUSED(task_count);
032581:     return true;
032582: }

032585:                                                                   CIrLabel* labels, u32 label_count, CScopeId root_scope, IrSourceRange source)

032715: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_initialize_cleanup_flags(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CDeclaration declaration)
032716: {
032717:     if (builder->cleanup_flag_count)
032718:     {

032721:         for (u32 cleanup_index = 0; cleanup_index < builder->cleanup_flag_count; cleanup_index += 1)
032722:         {
032723:             u32 entry_index = builder->cleanup_flag_base + cleanup_index;
032724:             CEntityId entity_id = builder->cleanup_entities[entry_index];
032725:             if (entity_id.value >= builder->parse.entity_count)
032726:             {
032727:                 return false;
032728:             }
032729:             IrValueId flag = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, builder->bool_type, source);
032730:             IrValueId inactive = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->bool_type);
032731:             if (flag.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || inactive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
032732:                 !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, inactive, source))
032733:             {
032734:                 return false;
032735:             }
032736:             builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index] = flag;
032737:         }
032738:     }
032739: 
032740:     return true;

032743: typedef struct CIrSwitchCase CIrSwitchCase;
032744: struct CIrSwitchCase
032745: {
032746:     u32 label_start;
032747:     u32 content_start;
032748:     u32 content_end;
032749:     CIrConstantValue low_constant;
032750:     CIrConstantValue high_constant;
032751:     u64 value;
032752:     u64 high_value;
032753:     IrBlockId block;
032754:     bool is_default;
032755:     bool is_range;
032756:     // Set when the label prefixes a control statement's substatement rather
032757:     // than opening a new statement of the switch body — `if (c) case 1: ...`.
032758:     // Such a case still dispatches to a block of its own, but the block is
032759:     // reached by falling into it from the statement stream that contains it,
032760:     // so it owns no token range and gets no task.
032761:     bool in_substatement;
032762:     u8 reserved[1];
032763: };
032764: 
032765: // One case label whose block the statement stream has to branch into when it
032766: // reaches the label, keyed by the label's token index. Nested switches reuse
032767: // the switch-case scratch array, so this registry lives for the whole body.
032768: // A declaration between a switch's `{` and its first case label declares
032769: // objects the cases go on to use, but no statement stream ever reaches it:
032770: // the dispatch jumps straight to a label.  SQLite's lemon-generated parser
032771: // declares `YYMINORTYPE yylhsminor;` exactly there and half of its reduce
032772: // actions read it.  Give those objects their frame slots before the dispatch,
032773: // where they dominate every case block, and leave any initializer unrun --
032774: // which is what C says jumping past an initializer does.
032775: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_switch_prefix_locals(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 body_start, u32 prefix_end)
032776: {
032777:     CScopeId root = builder->declaration_index < builder->parse.declaration_count ? builder->parse.declarations[builder->declaration_index].scope
032778:                                                                                   : C_SCOPE_ID_INVALID;
032779:     CScopeId scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, body_start);
032780:     if (scope.value >= builder->parse.scope_count)
032781:     {
032782:         return true;
032783:     }
032784:     for (CEntityId entity = builder->parse.scopes[scope.value].first_entity; entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count;
032785:          entity = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].next_in_scope)
032786:     {
032787:         CEntity* value = builder->parse.entities + entity.value;
032788:         u32 declaration_token = value->declaration_token_plus_one ? value->declaration_token_plus_one - 1 : UINT32_MAX;
032789:         if (value->kind != C_ENTITY_LOCAL || value->is_static_storage || value->is_thread_local || declaration_token < body_start ||
032790:             declaration_token >= prefix_end || value->type.value >= builder->parse.type_count || c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity))
032791:         {
032792:             continue;
032793:         }
032794:         IrTypeId local_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[value->type.value];
032795:         IrType* local_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, local_type);
032796:         u32 alignment = local_type_value ? local_type_value->layout.alignment : 0;
032797:         String8 rejection = {0};
032798:         if (!local_type_value || !local_type_value->layout.resolved ||
032799:             c_ir_alignment_evaluate(builder, value->alignment_start, value->alignment_count, alignment, &alignment, 0, &rejection) != C_IR_ALIGNMENT_RESOLVED ||
032800:             c_ir_emit_local(builder, builder->preprocess.tokens[declaration_token], local_type, entity, alignment).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032801:         {
032802:             builder->failure_message =
032803:                 rejection.length ? rejection
032804:                                  : string_format(builder->arena, S8("could not declare local '{S8}', which precedes the first case label of a switch"), value->name);
032805:             builder->failure_kind_plus_one = rejection.length ? C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_ALIGNMENT + 1 : 0;
032806:             builder->failure_token_index = declaration_token;
032807:             return false;
032808:         }
032809:     }
032810:     return true;
032811: }
032812: 
032813: typedef struct CIrSubstatementCase CIrSubstatementCase;
032814: struct CIrSubstatementCase
032815: {
032816:     u32 label_start;

032818:     IrBlockId block;
