032821: typedef struct CIrLabel CIrLabel;
032822: 
032823: // The registry is keyed by token index, which is unique across the body, so a
032824: // nested switch's labels can never be mistaken for an outer switch's. Bodies
032825: // carry a handful of these at most, so a linear scan is the whole lookup.
032826: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrSubstatementCase* c_ir_substatement_case_find(CIrLowerBodyState* state, u32 label_start)
032827: {
032828:     CIrSubstatementCase* result = 0;
032829:     for (u32 index = 0; index < state->substatement_case_count && !result; index += 1)
032830:     {
032831:         if (state->substatement_cases[index].label_start == label_start)
032832:         {
032833:             result = state->substatement_cases + index;
032834:         }
032835:     }
032836: 
032837:     return result;
032838: }
032839: 
032840: // A colon only introduces a labeled statement when it is itself a label,
032841: // case, or default colon; a conditional's colon can directly precede an
032842: // `identifier :` pair (`b ? b ? c : s : l`), where `s` is not a label. Pair
032843: // nested `? :` groups backward to the statement boundary: an unmatched `?`
032844: // claims the colon for a conditional expression.
032845: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL BUSTER_COLD BUSTER_PRESERVE_MOST bool c_ir_label_colon_at(CToken* tokens, u32 body_start, u32 colon_index)
032846: {
032847:     u32 parentheses = 0;
032848:     u32 brackets = 0;
032849:     u32 braces = 0;
032850:     u32 pending_colons = 0;

033501:     if (value_count >= UINT16_MAX)
033502:     {
033503:         return false;
033504:     }
033505:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
033506:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_SWITCH, builder->void_type);
033507:     instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
033508:     instruction.operands[0] = switched;
033509:     instruction.operand_count = 1;
033510:     instruction.targets = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrBlockId, value_count + 1);
033511:     instruction.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, value_count);
033512:     u32 value_index = 0;
033513:     for (u32 index = 0; index < case_count; index += 1)
033514:     {
033515:         if (!cases[index].is_default)
033516:         {
033517:             instruction.targets[value_index] = cases[index].block;
033518:             instruction.immediates[value_index] = cases[index].value;
033519:             value_index += 1;
033520:         }
033521:     }

033525:     if (c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
033526:     {
033527:         return false;
033528:     }
033529:     builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value].terminated = true;
033530:     return true;
033531: }

033554: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_terminate_switch_ranges(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId switched, CIrSwitchCase* cases, u32 case_count,
033555:                                                       IrBlockId default_block, IrSourceRange source)
033556: {
033557:     (void)source;
033558:     IrBlockId dispatch = builder->current_block;
033559:     for (u32 case_index = 0; case_index < case_count; case_index += 1)
033560:     {
033561:         CIrSwitchCase* current = cases + case_index;
033562:         if (current->is_default)
033563:         {
033564:             continue;
033565:         }
033566:         IrBlockId miss = default_block;
033567:         for (u32 next = case_index + 1; next < case_count; next += 1)
033568:         {
033569:             if (!cases[next].is_default)
033570:             {
033571:                 miss = c_ir_block_create(builder);
033572:                 break;
033573:             }
033574:         }
033575:         if (miss.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, dispatch))
033576:         {
033577:             return false;
033578:         }
033579:         CToken label = builder->preprocess.tokens[current->label_start];
033580:         IrSourceRange label_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, label);
033581:         IrValueId lower = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, current->value, false, label, builder->function->values[switched.value].canonical_type);
033582:         if (lower.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
033583:         {
033584:             return false;
033585:         }
033586:         IrValueId condition = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
033587:         IrValueId operands[2] = {switched, lower};
033588:         u32 operand_count = 2;
033589:         if (current->is_range)
033590:         {
033591:             IrBlockId upper_check = c_ir_block_create(builder);
033592:             if (upper_check.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
033593:                 !c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_GREATER_EQUAL, operands, &operand_count, label_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) ||
033594:                 operand_count != 1)
033595:             {
033596:                 return false;
033597:             }
033598:             condition = c_ir_truth_value(builder, operands[0], label_source);
033599:             if (condition.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
033600:             {
033601:                 return false;
033602:             }

033653: // The storage a variable-length array declaration allocates, and the local
033654: // that names it. A VLA local is a pointer variable: the ALLOCATE moves the
033655: // stack pointer by the runtime size and the pointer it produces is stored into
033656: // the local's frame slot, which is what every later index and sizeof reads
033657: // through. Both declaration paths emit it -- the single declarator in
033658: // c_ir_lower_body_advance and a declarator split out of a list in
033659: // c_ir_prepare_automatic_declaration -- so it lives here rather than in either.
033660: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_vla_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrVlaLayout* layout, IrTypeId pointer_type_id, IrTypeId element_type,
033661:                                              CEntityId entity, CToken name, u32 alignment)
033662: {
033663:     IrValueId storage = c_ir_add_result(builder, pointer_type_id);
033664:     bool emitted = layout->runtime_size.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && storage.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
033665:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_source_range(c_ir_token_location(builder, name), name.length);
033666:     if (emitted)
033667:     {
033668:         IrInstruction allocation = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_STACK_ALLOCATE, pointer_type_id);
033669:         allocation.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
033670:         allocation.operands[0] = layout->runtime_size;
033671:         allocation.operand_count = 1;
033672:         allocation.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
033673:         allocation.immediates[0] = alignment;
033674:         allocation.immediate_count = 1;
033675:         allocation.result = storage;
033676:         builder->function->values[storage.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, allocation, source);
033677:         IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pointer_type_id);
033678:         IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_local(builder, name, pointer_type_id, entity, pointer_type ? pointer_type->layout.alignment : alignment);
033679:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
033680:         emitted = place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && local;
033681:         if (emitted)
033682:         {
033683:             local->runtime_size = layout->runtime_size;
033684:             local->vla_element_type = element_type;
033685:             local->vla_dimension_counts = layout->dimension_counts;
033686:             local->vla_suffix_sizes = layout->suffix_sizes;
033687:             local->vla_dimension_count = layout->dimension_count;
033688:             local->is_variable_length_array = true;
033689:             c_ir_vla_local_shape(builder, local);
033690:             emitted = c_ir_emit_store(builder, local, storage, source);
033691:         }
033692:         if (emitted)
033693:         {
033694:             c_ir_mark_local_read_only(builder, local);
033695:             emitted = c_ir_activate_cleanup(builder, entity, source);
033696:         }
033697:     }
033698: 
033699:     return emitted;
033700: }

033528:     }
033529:     builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value].terminated = true;
033530:     return true;
033531: }

033533: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_switch_promoted_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id)
033534: {
033535:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
033536:     IrTypeId result;
033537:     if (!type || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM || (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width < 32))
033538:     {
033539:         result = builder->s32_type;
033540:     }
033541:     else
033542:     {
033543:         result = type_id;
033544:     }
033545: 
033546:     return result;
033547: }

033549: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_switch_integer_less_equal(IrType* type, u64 left, u64 right)
033550: {
033551:     return type->is_signed ? c_ir_integer_signed_value(left, type) <= c_ir_integer_signed_value(right, type) : left <= right;

033554: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_terminate_switch_ranges(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId switched, CIrSwitchCase* cases, u32 case_count,
033555:                                                       IrBlockId default_block, IrSourceRange source)
033556: {
033557:     (void)source;
033558:     IrBlockId dispatch = builder->current_block;
033559:     for (u32 case_index = 0; case_index < case_count; case_index += 1)
033560:     {
033561:         CIrSwitchCase* current = cases + case_index;
033562:         if (current->is_default)
033563:         {
033564:             continue;
033565:         }
033566:         IrBlockId miss = default_block;
033567:         for (u32 next = case_index + 1; next < case_count; next += 1)
033568:         {
033569:             if (!cases[next].is_default)
033570:             {
033571:                 miss = c_ir_block_create(builder);
033572:                 break;
033573:             }
033574:         }
033575:         if (miss.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, dispatch))
033576:         {
033577:             return false;
033578:         }
033579:         CToken label = builder->preprocess.tokens[current->label_start];
033580:         IrSourceRange label_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, label);
033581:         IrValueId lower = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, current->value, false, label, builder->function->values[switched.value].canonical_type);
033582:         if (lower.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
033583:         {
033584:             return false;
033585:         }
033586:         IrValueId condition = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
033587:         IrValueId operands[2] = {switched, lower};
033588:         u32 operand_count = 2;
033589:         if (current->is_range)
033590:         {
033591:             IrBlockId upper_check = c_ir_block_create(builder);
033592:             if (upper_check.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
033593:                 !c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_GREATER_EQUAL, operands, &operand_count, label_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) ||
033594:                 operand_count != 1)
033595:             {
033596:                 return false;
033597:             }
033598:             condition = c_ir_truth_value(builder, operands[0], label_source);
033599:             if (condition.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
033600:             {
033601:                 return false;
033602:             }
033603:             IrBlockId lower_targets[2] = {upper_check, miss};
033604:             if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &condition, 1, lower_targets, 2, label_source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, upper_check))
033605:             {
033606:                 return false;
033607:             }
033608:             IrValueId upper = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, current->high_value, false, label,
033609:                                                              builder->function->values[switched.value].canonical_type);
033610:             if (upper.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
033611:             {
033612:                 return false;
033613:             }
033614:             operands[0] = switched;
033615:             operands[1] = upper;
033616:             operand_count = 2;
033617:             if (!c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_LESS_EQUAL, operands, &operand_count, label_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) ||
033618:                 operand_count != 1)
033619:             {
033620:                 return false;
033621:             }
033622:             condition = c_ir_truth_value(builder, operands[0], label_source);
033623:             if (condition.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
033624:             {
033625:                 return false;
033626:             }
033627:         }
033628:         else
033629:         {
033630:             operands[0] = switched;
033631:             operands[1] = lower;
033632:             operand_count = 2;
033633:             if (!c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_EQUAL, operands, &operand_count, label_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) || operand_count != 1)
033634:             {
033635:                 return false;

033702: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_prepare_automatic_declaration(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerAutomaticDeclarationState* state,
033703:                                                              u32* expression_start_out, u32* expression_end_out, bool* expression_pending_out)
033704: {
033705:     u32 start = state->start;
033706:     u32 end = state->end;
033707:     *expression_pending_out = false;
033708:     CEntityId entity = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
033709:     u32 name_index = end;
033710:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
033711:     {
033712:         if (builder->preprocess.tokens[index].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
033713:         {
033714:             continue;
033715:         }
033716:         CEntityId candidate = c_ir_local_entity_at(builder, index);
033717:         if (candidate.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[candidate.value].kind == C_ENTITY_LOCAL)
033718:         {
033719:             entity = candidate;
033720:             name_index = index;
033721:             break;
033722:         }
033723:     }
033724:     if (name_index >= end || entity.value >= builder->parse.entity_count)
033725:     {
033726:         builder->failure_message = S8("could not resolve the automatic local declaration");
033727:         return false;
033728:     }
